f4b58c58.title: Presales Engineer
f4b58c58.description:
**Designation: Presales Engineer**

**Preferred Experience: 3+ Years**

**Location: Pune - Hybrid**

Job Summary

We are looking for a Presales Engineer with a strong technical background who can understand complex technical products and translate them into compelling solutions for clients. The role involves working closely with sales, product, and engineering teams to conduct product demos, handle technical discussions, and support deal closures.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Technical Presales & Solutioning-**

● Understand customer requirements and map them to appropriate technical solutions.

● Analyze client use cases and recommend product configurations or custom solutions.

● Act as the technical point of contact during the sales cycle.

**Product Demonstrations-**

● Conduct technical product demos, proofs-of-concept (POCs), and walkthroughs for clients.

● Tailor demos based on customer industry, business challenges, and technical maturity.

●Clearly explain product architecture, features, and integrations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Cross-Functional & Go-To-Market Support-**

● Partner with sales teams to respond to RFPs, RFIs, and technical questionnaires.

● Assist in preparing proposals, presentations, and solution documentation.

● Support negotiations by addressing technical objections and concerns.

●Support cross-functional initiatives beyond presales, including marketing, events, and solution positioning, as required.

●Collaborate with the marketing team to contribute to solution collateral, including flyers, brochures, case studies, and pitch decks.

●Assist in webinars, conferences, industry events, and product launches by supporting demos, presentations, and technical storytelling.

●Translate technical capabilities into clear, customer-friendly messaging for digital and field marketing use cases.

**Stakeholder Collaboration-**

●Work closely with product and engineering teams to stay updated on new features and roadmap. ●Provide customer feedback to internal teams to improve product offerings.

●Ensure smooth handover from presales to delivery/implementation teams.

**Required Skills &**
**Qualifications**
:

**Technical Skills-**

●Strong understanding of software products, SaaS platforms, or enterprise solutions.

●Strong ownership mindset with attention to detail and follow-through.

●Comfort working with presentations, documentation, and visual storytelling for both technical and business audiences.

●Ability to understand system architecture, APIs, integrations, and workflows.

●Hands-on experience with demos, POCs, or solution presentations.

●Familiarity with cloud platforms, databases, or modern tech stacks is a plus.

**Soft Skills-**

●Excellent communication and presentation skills.

●Ability to explain complex technical concepts in a simple, business-friendly manner.

●Ability to work in cross-functional roles spanning presales, marketing, and customer engagement when required.

●Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

●Confident in client-facing interactions.

**Experience:**

●Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

●3 - 6 years of experience in presales, solutions engineering, technical consulting, or similar roles.

**Company Overview:**

Aventior is a leading provider of innovative, end-to-end technology solutions, empowering businesses across diverse industries to solve complex challenges and accelerate growth. We harness the power of cutting-edge technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), MLOps, and DevOps to build scalable, future-ready solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. Our expertise extends across the entire data lifecycle. We offer comprehensive data development and management services, including cloud data architecture, universal data models, Data Transformation & ETL, data lakes, user management, Analytics & visualization, and automated data capture for unstructured and semi-structured sources such as scanned documents.

These capabilities enable organizations to unlock the full value of their data and make faster, more informed decisions. At Aventior, our strength lies in combining deep industry expertise with advanced technical capabilities. Our teams work closely with clients to design and deliver tailored solutions that align with their unique business needs—whether it’s optimizing operations, enhancing customer experiences, or driving strategic decision-making. We bring a holistic, cross-industry perspective to every engagement, supported by a strong foundation in design, implementation, innovation, migration, and ongoing support. With a global delivery model, a multi-country presence, and a team of highly skilled professionals, Aventior is well-positioned to deliver consistent, high-quality outcomes at scale. Website: https://aventior.com/

5605d601.description:
**Presale Systems Engineer Networking Solutions**

Location : Bengaluru

Experience : 2 yrs

**Job Description**

* The selected person will work with the sales team to open and develop opportunities for solutions in Networking in the areas of Campus switching, Data Centre switching, Enterprise Wireless, QOS, SDWAN, Network Performance Management, Network management etc.
* The candidate will present solutions to the customer in the above areas, understand customer requirements, successfully set or modify customer requirements.
* The candidate will develop solution blueprint, document the same, collaborate with the OEM presale personnel where required, prepare the BoM for the opportunities engaged in.
* The candidate will evaluate multiple approaches based on customer objectives and constraints and will help the Salesperson with appropriate solution approach.
* The candidate will manage and handle all solution related queries from the customer evaluation team, in a timely manner and maintain high levels of CSAT.
* She/He will discuss with the customer / sales team and arrive at the Success Criteria for Proof of Concepts, where POCs are required and will be responsible for conducting and completing successful POCs, in time.
* She/He will conduct high quality demonstrations of the solution wherever required in course of pursuing an opportunity.
* She/He will be the thought leader and knowledge personnel in the above areas within the team and will conduct regular knowledge sharing sessions with the sales and technical team, to keep the whole team updated with latest trends, such that it eventually helps the business, by better conversion of pipeline and addition to the pipeline.
* She/He will create success stories of use cases handled in course of work, to share with all customers, as a showcase of the capabilities of the team.

Candidate Profile Requirements

* Good experience on Networking Presales
* Mandatory currently valid technical Certification on Cisco - CCNP for Wired and Wireless switching
* Knowledge and familiarity with solutions like SDWAN, NPM and QOS
* Good communication skills in English, Hindi and/or Indian regional languages of the region
* Able to work effectively with people and customers. Good presence with customers is mandatory.

Must be adept at collaborating with multiple stakeholders to deliver business outcomes

**Overview**
Engages with and reaches out to customers proactively and independently. Uses knowledge of customer context, solution or portfolio expertise, and technical and industry knowledge to build credibility with customers. Leads and ensures technical wins for core and adjacent technologies by leading technical discussions with customers and establishing rules of engagement. Leverages foundational knowledge of resources. Engages in partner sell-with scenarios by acting as liaison between the partner and team and facilitating partner resources and processes throughout the course of the project. Supports partner technical capacity by identifying skill and resource gaps and providing feedback to internal teams. Captures core competitive knowledge and delivers back to product and engineering teams to enhance team capabilities and develop compete strategies for assigned customers. Provides strategic, technical, and partner input based on Microsoft capability at the account level to contribute to strategy development, leveraging partner, competitor, or open-source knowledge.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Build Strategy
  
  
Works with account and marketing teams to shape strategic win and customer success plans and tailor Microsoft messaging to audience using knowledge of customer feedback, specific Microsoft solutions, and their context in a competitive landscape. Where applicable, builds consumption plans with Partner and Industry Solutions Delivery teams after customer sign-off.
  
  
Captures core competitive knowledge and delivers back to product and engineering teams to enhance team capabilities and develop compete strategies for assigned customers.
  
  
Provides strategic, technical, and partner input based on Microsoft capability at the account level to contribute to strategy development, leveraging partner, competitor, or open-source knowledge.
  
  
Education
  
  
Monitors and responds to internal tech community posts, attends community calls, sessions, hackathons, etc., and acts as a mentor for their technology area.
  
  
Demonstrates new and updated products to increase internal virtual teams' understanding of solutions and new opportunities, emphasizing continuous security enhancement and regulatory compliance.
  
  
Builds their own readiness plan and proactively identifies learning gaps. Grows domain knowledge and practices expertise by communicating with customers, partners, and senior colleagues to expand knowledge of architecture.
  
  
Leverage Partner Ecosystem
  
  
Supports partner technical capacity by identifying skill and resource gaps and providing feedback to internal teams (e.g., Global Partner Solutions).
  
  
Engages in partner sell-with scenarios by acting as liaison between the partner and team and facilitating partner resources and processes throughout the course of the project.
  
  
Scale Customer Engagements
  
  
Leverages foundational knowledge of resources (e.g., roles, Microsoft Technology Center [MTC], demo sites, virtual sites, Value Based Delivery [VBD], Customer Success Unit [CSU]) and proactively engages product teams (e.g., engineering) to remediate blockers by conveying impact.
  
  
Uses knowledge of customer context, solution or portfolio expertise, and technical and industry knowledge to build credibility with customers and act as a trusted advisor to assess and consult on their security needs.
  
  
Engages with and reaches out to customers proactively and independently.

Solution Design and Proof
  
  
Presents and applies architecture patterns to partners or customers and drives cross-workload support for Microsoft Solutions.
  
  
Applies sales methodologies (e.g., challenger sales) and coaches team in addressing customer digital transformation, underscoring security improvements and leveraging insights to align new or changing technology to customer business needs.
  
  
Demonstrates and oversees demonstrations (e.g., architectural design sessions, and proof of concept [POC] sessions) of products, services, and integration through initial engagements. Leverages partner/customer teams as needed to prove capabilities and integration into customer environment.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required/minimum qualifications
  
  
Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 5+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 4+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR 5+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR equivalent experience.
  
  
**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**
6+ years technical pre-sales, technical consulting, or technology delivery, or related experience OR equivalent experience.
  
  
4+ years experience with cloud and hybrid, or on premises infrastructures, architecture designs, migrations, industry standards, and/or technology management.
  
  
Certification in relevant technologies or disciplines (e.g., Office 365, Power BI, Azure Architect and Development exams, Cloud Platform Technologies, Information Security, Architecture).
  
  
This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

c2ca3125.title: Solution Architect EMEA
c2ca3125.description:
**Description**
Company Overview:
  
  
When it comes to IT solution providers, there are a lot of choices. But when it comes to providers with innovative and differentiating end-to-end service offerings, there’s really only one: Zones – First Choice for IT.TM
  
  
Zones is a Global Solution Provider of end-to-end IT solutions with an unmatched supply chain. Positioned to be the IT partner you need, Zones, a Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) in business for over 35 years, specializes in Digital Workplace, Cloud & Data Center, Networking, Security, and Managed/Professional/Staffing services. Operating in more than 120 countries, leveraging a robust portfolio, and utilizing the highest certification levels from key partners, including Microsoft, Apple, Cisco, Lenovo, Adobe, and more, Zones has mastered the science of building digital infrastructures that change the way business does business ensuring whatever they need, they can Consider IT Done. Follow Zones, LLC on Twitter @Zones, and LinkedIn and Facebook.
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Solution Architect – EMEA is responsible for designing innovative, scalable, and commercially viable IT solutions for enterprise customers across the EMEA region. Working closely with Sales, Delivery, Technology Partners, and Customers, this role drives solution design, presales strategy, proposal development, and customer presentations to help secure new business and accelerate growth.
  
  
What you’ll do as the [Solution Architect – EMEA]:
  
  
The requirements below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. This job description is not intended to be a comprehensive list of the duties and responsibilities of the position, and the duties and responsibilities may change without notice.
  
  

* Create the Solution Design and Offering pitch.
* Work with technology vendors and create a collaboration plan & execution plan.
* Work with the internal delivery team for solution review and signoff.
* Work with the sales team for account identification and planning.
* Run the sales enablement initiative to educate the sales and presales team.
* Qualify incoming opportunities based on capabilities, risk, timelines
* Understand all dimensions of scope of the opportunity in its minutest detail – hardware, software, services, geography, time.
* Clearly identify variables that impact the solution and elicit all required clarifications from the client.
* Work with the proposal team to ensure that the solution that has been architected and priced is articulated in a compelling manner in the appropriate submission/presentation format.
* Participate remotely or in person in solution presentations / walk-throughs with clients.
* Develop/improve processes, tools, and metrics that enhance the quality, speed, and productivity of the solutioning processes.
* Craft solution design and effort estimation for Smart hands and feet support, (Installation, Commissioning, and Testing) of EUC, Audio - Visual and Video Conferencing Systems.
* Knowledge of products and systems such as EUC, Audio - Visual, Video Conferencing , Digital signage, POS devices, UPS, etc
* Work with field services partners for solutions and pricing.
* Knowledge of products and systems such as Audio - Visual Systems, Video walls, Digital signage, POS devices, UPS, etc.
* Eye for detail and competitive intelligence in ensuring that effort estimation, pricing, scope, and assumptions strike the right balance between the ability to win it as well as the ability to deliver it.
* Ability to create competitive proposals that reflect thought leadership and alternate creative options (when required).
* Strong presentation, public speaking and written articulation skills

**What You Will Bring To The Team**

* 10+ years of professional experience in information technology pre-sales or solution architecture with leading Technology Consulting firms
* Experience should span Hardware, Software, and Services – Professional Services and Managed Services ranging from small quick turnaround proposals to those that can span a few hundred million dollars
* Ability to articulate the solution in a compelling manner in written responses, solution presentations, and when necessary presenting the solution in an oral presentation to the client
* Deep understanding of cost and price benchmarks for products and services
* Ability to price proposals competitively thru global delivery coupled with a thorough understanding of cost-to-win and price-to-win benchmarks
* Strong knowledge of the product vendors and services providers in the IT space as well as strong knowledge of the competitive landscape.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and leadership skills
* Experience working in a globally distributed team.

Zones offers a comprehensive Benefits package.
  
  
While we’re committed to providing top-tier solutions, we’re just as committed to supporting our own teams. We offer a competitive compensation package where our team members are rewarded based on their performance and recognized for the value they bring into our business. Our team members enjoy a variety of comprehensive benefits, including Medical Insurance Coverage, Group Term Life and Personal Accident Cover to handle the uncertainties of life, flexible leave policy to balance their work life.
  
  
At Zones, work is more than a job – it's an exciting career immersed in an inventive, collaborative culture. If you’re interested in working on the cutting edge of IT innovation, sales, engineering, operations, administration, and more, Zones is the place for you!
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or pregnancy.

43d10b1f.title: Lead Solution Architect Consultant
43d10b1f.description:
Role- Lead Solution Architect  
Location- Bangalore  
Experience- 12- 16years

We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Solution Architect with 12+ years of experience in designing, developing, and deploying enterprise-scale AI/ML solutions across cloud and edge environments.

The candidate will be responsible for translating complex business and operational problems into secure, scalable, resilient, and production-ready AI/ML architectures, with a strong focus on Microsoft Azure, MLOps, data architecture, API design, and cloud-native application development.  
The ideal candidate will have a strong combination of solution architecture expertise and hands-on technical experience, with demonstrated success in taking AI/ML solutions from PoC pilot production enterprise scale.

Experience with Computer Vision, Generative AI, predictive analytics, industrial AI, IoT/OT, or edge AI will be highly valuable, particularly within Oil & Gas, Energy, Manufacturing, or other industrial environments.

**Key Responsibilities**  
1. AI/ML Solution Architecture  
• Define end-to-end architectures for enterprise AI/ML solutions covering:  
o Data ingestion  
o Data processing and engineering  
o Feature engineering  
o Model development and training  
o Model serving and inference  
o Application/API integration  
o Monitoring and governance  
• Translate business and operational requirements into scalable technical architectures.  
• Select appropriate AI/ML frameworks, cloud services, infrastructure, and deployment patterns.  
• Define architecture standards, reference architectures, design patterns, and technology roadmaps.  
• Evaluate emerging AI/ML technologies and assess their applicability to business problems.  
2. Computer Vision & Edge AI  
For computer-vision-driven solutions, the architect will:  
• Design architectures for camera edge cloud application workflows.  
• Architect real-time video/image analytics solutions.  
• Work with computer vision technologies such as:  
o YOLO and object detection models  
o OpenCV  
o CNN/Transformer-based models  
o Image classification  
o Object detection and tracking  
o Segmentation  
o OCR  
o Anomaly detection  
• Optimize models for edge and cloud deployment.  
• Design GPU-enabled inference environments using containers and Kubernetes where appropriate.

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. 1ff3f7df.description:
**Role:** AWS Cloud Delivery Engineer

**Experience:** 2+ Years

**Employment Type:** Full-time

  

Role Summary:

We are looking for an energetic and hands-on **AWS Cloud Delivery Engineer** with **2+ years of experience** to build and deploy cloud infrastructure for enterprise client engagements. You will assist and execute implementations focusing on multi-account landing zones (**AWS Control Tower**), hybrid enterprise connectivity (**VPN, Transit Gateway**), and containerized workloads (**Amazon EKS, ECS, and AWS Fargate**) using Infrastructure as Code (**Terraform**).

  

Key Responsibilities-

* **Landing Zone & Multi-Account Setup:** Deploy and configure multi-account environments using **AWS Control Tower** and AWS Organizations, applying baseline Service Control Policies (SCPs) and centralized IAM/SSO.
* **Hybrid Networking:** Set up VPCs, subnets, route tables, **AWS Transit Gateway (TGW)**, and IPSec **Site-to-Site VPN** connections to connect on-premises environments with AWS.
* **Containers & Modern Compute:** Deploy and support containerized workloads on **Amazon EKS** and **Amazon ECS / AWS Fargate**, ensuring proper networking, security groups, and auto-scaling.
* **Infrastructure as Code (IaC):** Write modular, reusable **Terraform** code and support deployment pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or AWS CodePipeline).
* **Security & Monitoring:** Configure basic cloud security controls (AWS Config, GuardDuty, IAM least-privilege) and centralized monitoring/logging with Amazon CloudWatch and CloudTrail.
* **Technical Documentation & KT:** Maintain architecture diagrams, runbooks, and participate in client handover/knowledge transfer sessions.

  

Required Skills & Qualifications-

* **Core AWS Experience (2+ years):** Proven hands-on track record working with VPC, EC2, S3, IAM, Route 53, and foundational AWS infrastructure services.
* **Control Tower / Multi-Account:** Direct exposure to setting up or managing AWS Control Tower, Organizations, and account provisioning workflows.
* **Networking Fundamentals:** Solid grasp of CIDR blocks, subnetting, route tables, NAT gateways, Transit Gateway, and Site-to-Site VPN configurations.
* **Containers:** Practical experience launching and operating containers using **ECS (EC2/Fargate launch types)** or **EKS**.
* **Automation & IaC:** Hands-on experience writing **Terraform** for AWS resource provisioning, along with basic Linux administration and shell scripting.
* **Communication & Delivery:** Strong team player with good communication skills for client updates, ticket handovers, and technical discussions.

  

Good to Have-

* Basic knowledge of Kubernetes tools (Helm, kubectl, manifests).
* Exposure to CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
* Familiarity with database migration basics (AWS DMS) or server migration tools (AWS MGN).

  

Preferred Certifications-

* **AWS Certified SysOps Administrator Associate**
* **AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate**
* **AWS Certified SysOps Administrator /Solution Architect Engineer – Professional** (Bonus)
* **Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)** or **Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)** (Bonus)

58c22ee3.description:
**Req ID:** 386803
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Z2\_Open Text Cloud Developer to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
Job Description – Expert OpenText Cloud Consultant
  
**Role:** Expert OpenText Cloud Consultant – Content Server, Archive Center, Intelligent Viewing, Directory Services Information Archive, with Kubernetes Helm
  
**Positions:** 1
  
  
Role Summary
  
The Expert OpenText Cloud Consultant leads the cloud and containerized delivery of the OpenText platform. The role designs and implements enterprise-grade deployments of Content Server, Archive Center, Intelligent Viewing, Directory Services and Cloud Information Archive on OpenText Cloud (CSP) and Kubernetes, including Helm-based packaging, CI/CD, observability, resilience and operational readiness.
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Design and implement OpenText Cloud (CSP) deployments of Content Server, Archive Center, Intelligent Viewing and Directory Services, including tenant setup, environment topology and hybrid connectivity to on-premises systems.
* Design and implement Cloud Information Archive: ingestion pipelines, indexing, search, retention policies, legal hold and compliance/eDiscovery capabilities.
* Build, maintain and version Helm charts and Kubernetes manifests for the in-scope products: configuration management, secrets via a managed secrets store, resource requests/limits, liveness/readiness probes, autoscaling, affinity rules and rolling upgrade strategies.
* Implement enterprise-grade Kubernetes practices: namespace and RBAC design, network policies, pod security standards, non-root containers, pinned and scanned images, and image supply-chain hygiene.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines for image build, chart packaging, environment promotion and automated rollback.
* Implement observability: centralized logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, SLOs and alerting for containerized OpenText workloads.
* Design and validate resilience: high availability, multi-zone deployment, backup and restore, disaster-recovery runbooks and periodic failover testing.
* Own cloud cutover planning and execution: migration of workloads from on-premises to cloud, dry runs, rollback plans and hypercare.
* Perform performance and capacity engineering: sizing, load testing, tuning of application, storage and database layers; cloud cost optimization.
* Ensure security and compliance of cloud deployments: TLS everywhere, encryption at rest, key and certificate management, least-privilege identities, audit logging, vulnerability scanning and patching.
* Act as expert advisor on OpenText Cloud roadmap, service limits, upgrade cycles and vendor coordination.
* Produce operational runbooks, as-built documentation and deliver knowledge transfer to internal operations teams.
* Service mesh, API gateway and ingress controller configuration.
* Database operations for ECM workloads (SQL Server/PostgreSQL) including HA and backup strategies.
* Cost management and FinOps practices for cloud workloads.
* Large-scale archive migration to cloud archiving platforms.
* Cloud/CSP deployment architecture and environment topology documentation.
* Production-grade Helm charts, Kubernetes manifests and per-environment configuration.
* CI/CD pipeline definitions for build, deploy and rollback.
* Observability setup: dashboards, alerts and SLO definitions.
* Backup/restore and disaster-recovery design plus tested runbooks.
* Cloud Information Archive configuration and compliance/retention setup.
* Cutover, rollback and hypercare plans; post-go-live reports.
* Operational runbooks, as-built documentation and knowledge transfer.

Required Skills
  

* Deployment and operation of OpenText Content Server, Archive Center, Intelligent Viewing, Directory Services, and Information Archive in cloud and/or containerized environments.
* OpenText Cloud (CSP) service model: tenant onboarding, environment management, connectivity and vendor interaction.
* OpenText Information Archive / Cloud Information Archive: ingestion, retention, search, compliance and eDiscovery configuration.
* Strong Kubernetes skills: workloads, services, ingress, storage classes and persistent volumes, ConfigMaps/Secrets, RBAC, network policies, autoscaling, troubleshooting.
* Strong Helm skills: authoring and maintaining production-grade charts, templating, values management per environment, chart versioning and release management.
* CI/CD tooling and GitOps-style deployment workflows.
* Observability tooling: logging, metrics, tracing and alerting stacks.
* Cloud networking and security: TLS/mTLS, certificate lifecycle, secrets management, identity and access management, hardening standards.
* Backup, restore and disaster recovery design and testing for stateful enterprise workloads.
* Relevant certifications in Kubernetes or a major cloud platform.

Soft Skills
  

* Expert-level autonomy in complex cloud and hybrid environments.
* Strong troubleshooting across application, container, network and storage layers.
* Pragmatic risk awareness with a strong operational and security mindset.
* Effective collaboration with architecture, development, infrastructure and vendor teams.

We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. e43bb598.description:
**Practice**
Delivery Management, Avanade India
  
  
**Location**
Bengaluru / Delhi NCR, India (Hybrid, with client travel)
  
  
**Experience**
12–15 years in IT, with proven delivery ownership of projects in one or more of cloud migration and application modernisation, data transformation, or CRM/ERP transformation — running teams of eight to ten people, with hands-on delivery experience on Microsoft technologies
  
  
**Role Summary**
Avanade India is looking for a Project Manager to take end-to-end delivery ownership of client projects across cloud modernisation, data and business applications. This is a delivery leadership role for someone who has carried the plan, the budget, the team and the client relationship on real projects — not only reported on them.
  
  
You will run projects with teams distributed across different locations, own scope, schedule, cost, quality and risk, and be the client’s day-to-day point of accountability. We are not looking for experience in every domain: depth in one or two — cloud migration, application modernisation, data transformation, or a CRM or ERP programme — matters more than shallow coverage of all four. Experience delivering on Microsoft technologies is expected, as most of our work sits on the Microsoft stack.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of client projects — initiation, planning, execution, go-live and closure — against agreed scope, schedule, cost and quality.
* Build and maintain the project plan: work breakdown, estimates, dependencies, critical path, milestones and release schedule.
* Lead a delivery team of consisting of architects, developers, testers and analysts, including distributed onshore and offshore members.
* Own the commercials of the project — budget, forecast, effort tracking, resource utilization, revenue recognition and margin — and flag variance early.
* Run governance: steering committees, weekly status, RAID logs, dashboards and reporting to client and internal stakeholders.
* Manage scope and change control — impact assessment, change requests, re-baselining and the commercial conversation that goes with them.
* Identify, track and mitigate risks and issues, and escalate with a recommendation rather than only a problem.
* Act as the client’s day-to-day delivery contact, building trust with business and IT stakeholders and managing expectations through the difficult parts of a project.
* Run delivery in the method the engagement needs — agile, waterfall or hybrid — including sprint ceremonies, backlog management and release planning.
* Coordinate the delivery lifecycle across teams: requirements, design, build, testing (SIT/UAT), data migration, cutover, hypercare and transition to support.
* Manage resourcing and onboarding, workload allocation and knowledge continuity across the team.
* Hold quality and compliance — delivery standards, documentation, security and client policy requirements — and prepare for internal and client audits.
* Manage third parties, client teams and Microsoft or partner resources where they form part of the delivery.
* Support presales and account growth — estimation, delivery approach, plans for proposals, and identifying extension opportunities on live projects.
* Coach team members and junior project managers, and contribute delivery templates and lessons learned to the practice.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 12–15 years of overall IT experience, with at least 5–6 years managing project delivery end to end.
* Proven delivery of projects in one or more of: cloud migration, application modernization, data platform or data transformation, and CRM or ERP transformation.
* Experience delivering on Microsoft technologies — Azure, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Microsoft 365, Fabric or the wider stack.
* Demonstrated experience running teams of upto 15-20 resources, including distributed onshore and offshore members.
* Strong command of project management disciplines: estimation, planning, scheduling, budgeting, RAID management, change control and reporting.
* Hands-on with project management and delivery tooling — Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, Jira, Planner, Excel-based tracking and reporting dashboards.
* Experience running both agile and waterfall delivery, and knowing which one a given engagement actually needs.
* Commercial awareness — managing budget, effort, utilization and margin, and handling scope and change commercially.
* Strong client-facing skills — steering committee presence, stakeholder management, and holding difficult conversations well.
* Experience across the full delivery lifecycle including testing, data migration, cutover, go-live and hypercare.
* Clear written communication — status reports, plans, governance packs and escalation notes at client-ready quality.

**Qualifications**

* Certifications: PMP, PRINCE2, Certified ScrumMaster or SAFe; Microsoft fundamentals certifications such as AZ-900, MS-900, PL-900 or DP-900.
* Experience in a consulting, global delivery or SI environment (Avanade, Accenture, or similar).
* Experience managing fixed-price as well as time-and-materials engagements.
* Exposure to programme management — coordinating several workstreams or projects under one client outcome.
* Background as a technical or functional consultant before moving into delivery management.
* Experience with client-side change management and adoption workstreams alongside technical delivery.
* Industry depth in one or more of BFSI, manufacturing, retail, energy, healthcare or public sector.
* Experience working with Microsoft field or partner teams on co-delivered engagements.
* Contribution to delivery accelerators, templates, estimation models or practice-building initiatives.

Our team owns some of the Science charter of AHS and specifically the Evaluations of Health AI and Integrations team (integration of Health AI and Pharmacy) along with all of the data that powers our optimization and valuation services.
  
  
We are seeking a lead Technical Program Manager to partner with our Engineering, Product, Science and Marketing teams to deliver world class experiences for our customers. This position will require a broad set of skills that will range from deep-dive analytical problem solving, working with engineering, understanding science to executive reporting. You will be working directly with engineering and science tech teams, Product and business teams, and all of our partner teams, which include teams within and outside of AHS.  
  
The right person will demonstrate proven track of software delivery and good management experience to manage numerous stakeholders and ambiguous processes; understand how to evaluate control effectiveness; understand potential risks and how to address them; provide in-depth consultation; be able to deliver high priority projects; and have the ability to prioritize mitigation efforts using risk management concepts. We are looking for a leader who excels at building and managing mechanisms, continuously evaluating how to improve these mechanisms, and then revising on an ongoing basis. AHS is in start-up mode, and we are seeking a leader that is flexible, dynamic, and can proactively make recommendations on how to improve our approach.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Architecting, building, and owning mechanisms between technical teams and our partners. Surfacing status and key issues with partner development and ensuring projects stay on task,  
  
Identifying and problem-solving risks across the software development lifecycle and developing escalation paths where appropriate,  
  
Owning key business processes and leadership mechanisms for flagship projects and coordinating task development and completion,  
  
Supporting career development and growth within the team by sharing mechanism best practices and participating in the team’s recruiting efforts  
  
About the team  
Amazon’s mission is to make it dramatically easier for customers to access the healthcare products and services they need to get and stay healthy. Towards this mission, we (Health Store and Tech) are building the technology, products and services, that help customers find, buy, and engage with the healthcare solutions they need.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

428253cf.title: Project Manager — Cloud, Data & Business Applications
428253cf.description:
Job Description
  

**Project Manager — Cloud, Data & Business Applications**

  

**Practice**

Delivery Management, Avanade India

**Location**

Bengaluru / Delhi NCR, India (Hybrid, with client travel)

  

**Experience**

12–15 years in IT, with proven delivery ownership of projects in one or more of cloud migration and application modernisation, data transformation, or CRM/ERP transformation — running teams of eight to ten people, with hands-on delivery experience on Microsoft technologies

  

**Role Summary**

Avanade India is looking for a Project Manager to take end-to-end delivery ownership of client projects across cloud modernisation, data and business applications. This is a delivery leadership role for someone who has carried the plan, the budget, the team and the client relationship on real projects — not only reported on them.

You will run projects with teams distributed across different locations, own scope, schedule, cost, quality and risk, and be the client’s day-to-day point of accountability. We are not looking for experience in every domain: depth in one or two — cloud migration, application modernisation, data transformation, or a CRM or ERP programme — matters more than shallow coverage of all four. Experience delivering on Microsoft technologies is expected, as most of our work sits on the Microsoft stack.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of client projects — initiation, planning, execution, go-live and closure — against agreed scope, schedule, cost and quality.

* Build and maintain the project plan: work breakdown, estimates, dependencies, critical path, milestones and release schedule.

* Lead a delivery team of consisting of architects, developers, testers and analysts, including distributed onshore and offshore members.

* Own the commercials of the project — budget, forecast, effort tracking, resource utilization, revenue recognition and margin — and flag variance early.

* Run governance: steering committees, weekly status, RAID logs, dashboards and reporting to client and internal stakeholders.

* Manage scope and change control — impact assessment, change requests, re-baselining and the commercial conversation that goes with them.

* Identify, track and mitigate risks and issues, and escalate with a recommendation rather than only a problem.

* Act as the client’s day-to-day delivery contact, building trust with business and IT stakeholders and managing expectations through the difficult parts of a project.

* Run delivery in the method the engagement needs — agile, waterfall or hybrid — including sprint ceremonies, backlog management and release planning.

* Coordinate the delivery lifecycle across teams: requirements, design, build, testing (SIT/UAT), data migration, cutover, hypercare and transition to support.

* Manage resourcing and onboarding, workload allocation and knowledge continuity across the team.

* Hold quality and compliance — delivery standards, documentation, security and client policy requirements — and prepare for internal and client audits.

* Manage third parties, client teams and Microsoft or partner resources where they form part of the delivery.

* Support presales and account growth — estimation, delivery approach, plans for proposals, and identifying extension opportunities on live projects.

Coach team members and junior project managers, and contribute delivery templates and lessons learned to the practice.  

  

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 12–15 years of overall IT experience, with at least 5–6 years managing project delivery end to end.

* Proven delivery of projects in one or more of: cloud migration, application modernization, data platform or data transformation, and CRM or ERP transformation.

* Experience delivering on Microsoft technologies — Azure, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Microsoft 365, Fabric or the wider stack.

* Demonstrated experience running teams of upto 15-20 resources, including distributed onshore and offshore members.

* Strong command of project management disciplines: estimation, planning, scheduling, budgeting, RAID management, change control and reporting.

* Hands-on with project management and delivery tooling — Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, Jira, Planner, Excel-based tracking and reporting dashboards.

* Experience running both agile and waterfall delivery, and knowing which one a given engagement actually needs.

* Commercial awareness — managing budget, effort, utilization and margin, and handling scope and change commercially.

* Strong client-facing skills — steering committee presence, stakeholder management, and holding difficult conversations well.

* Experience across the full delivery lifecycle including testing, data migration, cutover, go-live and hypercare.

* Clear written communication — status reports, plans, governance packs and escalation notes at client-ready quality.

  
Qualification
  

* Certifications: PMP, PRINCE2, Certified ScrumMaster or SAFe; Microsoft fundamentals certifications such as AZ-900, MS-900, PL-900 or DP-900.

* Experience in a consulting, global delivery or SI environment (Avanade, Accenture, or similar).

* Experience managing fixed-price as well as time-and-materials engagements.

* Exposure to programme management — coordinating several workstreams or projects under one client outcome.

* Background as a technical or functional consultant before moving into delivery management.

* Experience with client-side change management and adoption workstreams alongside technical delivery.

* Industry depth in one or more of BFSI, manufacturing, retail, energy, healthcare or public sector.

* Experience working with Microsoft field or partner teams on co-delivered engagements.

* Contribution to delivery accelerators, templates, estimation models or practice-building initiatives.

cf588bc0.title: Principal Solution Consultant
cf588bc0.description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
  
  
**The Role**
AspenTech is an AI-powered software company helping the world’s leading energy, chemical and engineering companies succeed in their digital transformation, making their operations more efficient and reducing impact on the environment. At AspenTech, you will be part of a global market-leading company with double-digit growth and a blue-chip customer base. We offer the opportunity to make an impact, to drive innovation and to be an agent of positive change. Our culture and vision have taken dramatic leaps forward over the past two years and we still have work to do. We need extraordinary individuals to pave the way ahead. We strive to make your story at AspenTech a great one.
  
  
As a Principal Solution Consultant, you will collaborate closely with AspenTech sales teams to lead consultative discovery sessions, craft visionary solutions, and design strategies tailored to customer needs. Your deep understanding of the industries and coupled with AspenTech's broad product portfolio and value-enablers will drive opportunities that deliver significant business value to our customers and AspenTech.
  
  
In this customer-facing role, you will leverage your technical domain expertise, industry knowledge, and business acumen to position AspenTech solutions effectively.
  
  
**Your Impact**

* Leading and executing the technical qualification of solutions to a business outcome.
* Serving as a discipline/practice subject matter expert with a strong understanding of operational challenges, best practices, and industry trends.
* Learning the complete AspenTech product portfolio to identify and apply products that solve real customer business challenges, including the value of solving those challenges.
* Developing the messaging and materials necessary to position AspenTech solutions in the industry – making adaptations for regional or market differences.
* Partnering closely with Sales Account Managers throughout the sales cycle, from discovery and solution design to executive presentations and deal execution.
* Engaging the senior executive level of customer organisations to paint the vision of how AspenTech can be a partner in their digitalisation journey.
* Developing industry-specific solutions, aligning technology with measurable business value.
* Providing market input to the Product Management teams to improve solution adoption.
* Identifying and leading sales campaigns to improve AspenTech’s reach, pipeline and awareness.
* Coaching and enabling Sales Account Managers and Solution Consultants on industry-specific messaging, customer engagement strategies and solution positioning.
* Representing AspenTech at industry conferences, customer forums, webinars and trade events across the region.

What You'll Need
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in industrial software, services, solution consulting, presales, technical sales or related customer-facing technical roles.
* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline (preferred).
* Proficiency in Industrial Data Platforms (Inmation), Historians (IP.21), and Advanced Process Control (APC) & Real Time Optimization (RTO) (DMC3, GDOT, Aspen Plus), or equivalent competitor technologies.
* Demonstrated successes in business development.
* Strong ability to bridge technology and business, articulating high-level technical solutions and their differentiated value.
* Strong drive to convert opportunities into recognised value for customers, with exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in English.
* Must be authorized to work in India without restriction/sponsorship.

**Nice-to-Have**

* Services or solution consulting exposure to industries such as Metals & Mining, LNG, Specialty Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Polymers, Consumer Packaged Goods, Food & Beverage, Pulp & Paper, Power Generation, and Water & Wastewater.
* Breadth across several AspenTech solution areas / well-rounded across multiple disciplines.
* Knowledge of AI/ML solutions and their application in industry.
* Strong understanding of digital transformation initiatives within asset-intensive industries.
* Working knowledge of Supply Chain/Production Planning & Scheduling - Aspen Plant Scheduler, Aspen Unified Planning, or equivalent competitor technologies. Regional travel up to 35%.

e5ce9dd0.title: Sr. Principal Solution Consultant
e5ce9dd0.description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
  
  
**The Role**
AspenTech is an AI-powered software company helping the world’s leading energy, chemical and engineering companies succeed in their digital transformation, making their operations more efficient and reducing impact on the environment. At AspenTech, you will be part of a global market-leading company with double-digit growth and a blue-chip customer base. We offer the opportunity to make an impact, to drive innovation and to be an agent of positive change. Our culture and vision have taken dramatic leaps forward over the past two years and we still have work to do. We need extraordinary individuals to pave the way ahead. We strive to make your story at AspenTech a great one.
  
  
As a Sr. Principal Solution Consultant, you will collaborate closely with AspenTech sales teams to lead consultative discovery sessions, craft visionary solutions, and design strategies tailored to customer needs. Your deep understanding of the industries and coupled with AspenTech's broad product portfolio and value-enablers will drive opportunities that deliver significant business value to our customers and AspenTech.
  
  
In this customer-facing role, you will leverage your technical domain expertise, industry knowledge, and business acumen to position AspenTech solutions effectively.
  
  
**Your Impact**

* Leading and executing the technical qualification of solutions to a business outcome.
* Serving as a discipline/practice subject matter expert with a strong understanding of operational challenges, best practices, and industry trends.
* Learning the complete AspenTech product portfolio to identify and apply products that solve real customer business challenges, including the value of solving those challenges.
* Developing the messaging and materials necessary to position AspenTech solutions in the industry – making adaptations for regional or market differences.
* Partnering closely with Sales Account Managers throughout the sales cycle, from discovery and solution design to executive presentations and deal execution.
* Engaging the senior executive level of customer organisations to paint the vision of how AspenTech can be a partner in their digitalisation journey.
* Developing industry-specific solutions, aligning technology with measurable business value.
* Providing market input to the Product Management teams to improve solution adoption.
* Identifying and leading sales campaigns to improve AspenTech’s reach, pipeline and awareness.
* Coaching and enabling Sales Account Managers and Solution Consultants on industry-specific messaging, customer engagement strategies and solution positioning.
* Representing AspenTech at industry conferences, customer forums, webinars and trade events across the region.

What You'll Need
  
  

* 14 + years of experience in industrial software, services, solution consulting, presales, technical sales or related customer-facing technical roles.
* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline (preferred).
* Proficiency in Industrial Data Platforms (Inmation), Historians (IP.21), and Advanced Process Control (APC) & Real Time Optimization (RTO) (DMC3, GDOT, Aspen Plus), or equivalent competitor technologies.
* Demonstrated successes in business development.
* Strong ability to bridge technology and business, articulating high-level technical solutions and their differentiated value.
* Strong drive to convert opportunities into recognised value for customers, with exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in English.
* Must be authorized to work in India without restriction/sponsorship.

**Nice-to-Have**

* Services or solution consulting exposure to industries such as Metals & Mining, LNG, Specialty Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Polymers, Consumer Packaged Goods, Food & Beverage, Pulp & Paper, Power Generation, and Water & Wastewater.
* Breadth across several AspenTech solution areas / well-rounded across multiple disciplines.
* Knowledge of AI/ML solutions and their application in industry.
* Strong understanding of digital transformation initiatives within asset-intensive industries.
* Working knowledge of Supply Chain/Production Planning & Scheduling - Aspen Plant Scheduler, Aspen Unified Planning, or equivalent competitor technologies.

Regional travel up to 35%.

bac4c731.title: Crm Architect
bac4c731.description:
Job Description: CRM Architect with AI Expertise

Role: CRM Architect / Technical Architect Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and AI

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced CRM Architect with strong expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM, Power Platform, Azure integrations, and AI-led solution development. The candidate will be responsible for designing scalable CRM architectures, leading technical implementation, guiding development teams, and driving AI-enabled automation using Copilot Studio, agentic development patterns, MCP-based integrations, and AI evaluation frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

* Design end-to-end CRM and Power Platform solutions aligned with business requirements, technical standards, scalability, security, and maintainability.
* Lead AI-enabled solution design using Copilot Studio, agentic development approaches, MCP development, AI evaluations, prompt optimization, and enterprise-grade automation patterns.
* Provide technical leadership across Dynamics 365 CRM development, Power Pages, plugins, JavaScript, Dataverse customization, workflows, and integrations.
* Guide teams on technical design, implementation approach, solution analysis, code quality, best practices, and delivery governance.
* Architect and support deployment processes including solution packaging, pipeline development, DevOps automation, release management, and environment strategy.
* Design and implement Azure-based integrations using Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, APIs, and .NET-based custom components.
* Support data and automation needs using ADF pipelines, integration patterns, orchestration flows, and reusable automation frameworks.
* Work closely with business stakeholders, customers, project managers, developers, and testing teams to translate requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Review solution designs, identify technical risks, recommend improvements, and ensure successful delivery of complex CRM and AI-driven initiatives.

Required Technical Skills

* **AI and Copilot Studio:** Hands-on knowledge of Copilot Studio, agentic development, MCP development, AI evaluations, prompt design, grounding, orchestration, and AI-assisted business process automation.
* **Dynamics 365 CRM and Dataverse:** Strong experience in CRM customization, configuration, plugins, workflows, business rules, JavaScript, C#, .NET, Dataverse security, and solution design.
* **Power Platform:** Good knowledge of Power Pages, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Platform governance, environment management, ALM, and reusable component development.
* **Deployments and DevOps:** Strong understanding of deployment planning, solution movement, pipeline development, automation, Azure DevOps, release governance, and environment readiness.
* **Azure Integrations:** Experience with Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, API integrations, authentication patterns, monitoring, and enterprise integration design.
* **Data and Automation:** Good knowledge of ADF pipelines, data movement, integration automation, data transformation, and operational process automation.

Leadership and Customer Engagement

* Ability to guide developers, review technical designs, mentor the team, and support implementation decisions across CRM, Power Platform, Azure, and AI solutions.
* Strong analytical skills to understand business problems, identify solution options, evaluate technical feasibility, and recommend the right architecture approach.
* Good customer communication skills with the ability to explain technical designs, risks, dependencies, and solution recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to lead design discussions, participate in requirement workshops, support estimation, and collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in enterprise CRM architecture, Power Platform modernization, AI-enabled automation, and large-scale Dynamics 365 implementations.
* Exposure to governance, security, monitoring, release management, and operational support for CRM and AI-driven enterprise solutions.
* Microsoft certifications in Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, or AI-related technologies are preferred.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on CRM Architect who can combine Dynamics 365 CRM, Power Platform, Azure integration, and AI expertise to deliver scalable, secure, and business-focused solutions. The candidate should be capable of owning architecture decisions, enabling AI-led modernization, supporting complex deployments, mentoring the team, and communicating effectively with customers and leadership stakeholders.

77d8d441.title: Principle Solutions Engineer
77d8d441.description:
**The Company**

Nomia helps companies reduce cost, manage risk, and increase efficiency for non-strategic third-party spend. We act as an extension of our customer's procurement team by executing the end-to-end sourcing, supplier onboarding and contracting process for indirect categories of spend.

We are focused on delivering an innovative and disruptive procurement solution to our customers to make managing non-strategic spend simpler, more transparent, and better value.

We are a global team based in the United Kingdom, Singapore, Dubai, Poland, and the United States.

Please note, Nomia operates on a hybrid model, with 3 days a week in the office, and 2 days a week working remotely.

**The Role**

As we scale, adding APIs, growing our teams and increasing the volume flowing through the platform, the Principal Solutions Engineer owns the architecture behind how we design and build across every engineering squad, and keeps the platform coherent, scalable and robust as a whole.

This is a hands-on, principal-level role. You set the technical direction across our teams and build the hardest parts yourself. We measure impact by decisions made, structure proven and working software shipped.

You’ll partner closely with Product to shape and de-risk new work, and work alongside our DevSecOps Engineer, who owns our infrastructure, environments and security. Together you’ll keep the platform fast, reliable and secure.

**Responsibilities**

**Architecture and scale**

* Define and own the target architecture for our Azure-based platform, ensuring it remains scalable, resilient, maintainable and cost-effective as products, teams and transaction volumes grow.
* Establish architectural standards, patterns and system boundaries that enable engineering teams to build consistently while minimising complexity and dependencies across the platform.
* Design secure, highly available cloud solutions, making informed decisions across networking, compute, data, messaging, identity, disaster recovery and regional resilience.

**Hands-on delivery**

* Lead the design, prototyping and first-pass implementation of new platform capabilities, validating architectural approaches before they are adopted by engineering teams.
* Contribute hands-on across the technology stack, including application development, cloud services, infrastructure configuration, CI/CD pipelines and platform integrations.
* Drive the evaluation and implementation of AI-enabled solutions, applying appropriate technologies and architectural patterns such as LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings and vector-based search where they add business value.

**APIs and integration**

* Own API and integration architecture across the platform, ensuring secure, resilient and scalable designs with robust versioning, authentication, authorisation and governance standards.

**Robustness, security and delivery**

* Define and champion performance, scalability, security and reliability standards, ensuring solutions are observable, supportable and ready for enterprise-scale operation.
* Partner closely with engineering and DevSecOps teams to optimise deployment strategies, CI/CD practices and cloud environments, enabling safe and efficient software delivery.

**Technical leadership**

* Act as a senior technical authority across the organisation, mentoring engineers and technical leads, guiding architectural decisions and translating emerging cloud and AI technologies into practical engineering solutions.

**Requirements**

**Essential Criteria**

* 8+ years of software engineering experience, with proven experience as a senior, staff or principal engineer, or platform/software architect, on a scaling SaaS platform. We’re looking for someone that can combine strong architectural and system-design skills with a proven track record of hands-on production coding and delivery.
* Strong API and integration design: contract-first, versioning and backward compatibility, sync vs async, idempotency (handling duplicate requests safely).
* A track record of making sound architecture decisions and seeing them through to working software.
* Experience designing for scale on cloud infrastructure (Azure), with a practical grasp of what breaks first as systems grow - the data tier, statelessness, caching and its costs.
* Fluent in modern delivery discipline: feature flags, percentage rollout, observability (Datadog or equivalent).
* Strong TypeScript and Node.js (Nomia’s core stack) with hands-on experience in Next.js, GitHub, CI/CD and DevOps practices, including GitHub Actions and deployment pipelines integrating with Azure.
* Excellent communication: able to set technical direction across teams, and to explain trade-offs clearly to non-specialist stakeholders.

**Desirable Criteria**

* Workflow orchestration (Workato or similar) and ERP integration experience.
* Exposure to AI / ML platform components, data pipelines, or event-sourced architectures.
* Procurement, marketplace or B2B transaction-platform domain experience.

**General Information**

* Adhere to Nomia's data protection and information security policies at all times.
* Promote diversity and inclusion in line with Nomia's core values.
* This is a hybrid role, with two office days per week required, potentially more during training or as requested by your supervisor.
* Contribute to continuous improvement in systems and processes.
* Please note that this role description is a guideline, and duties may evolve over time.

7336071c.title: CloudOps Engineer IV On-site — Full-time Chennai / Hyderabad
7336071c.description:
PDI Technologies is looking for a CloudOps Engineer IV to join the SRE organization supporting Paylo, PDI’s payments, loyalty, and fuel-pricing product suite. This is a senior, hands-on individual-contributor role focused on keeping high-traffic, customer- and partner-facing platforms reliable, secure, and running efficiently across multi-cloud infrastructure.

You will bring strong, hands-on experience across AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD, Terraform/OpenTofu, Jenkins, and Datadog, and apply it directly — building and operating infrastructure, improving deployment pipelines, and strengthening observability. You will work under the direction of the Senior Manager, SRE, executing against the team’s reliability and infrastructure roadmap while bringing your own judgment and technical leadership to the problems in front of you.

### **Job Responsibilities:**

Cloud Infrastructure & Operations:

* Build, operate, and troubleshoot infrastructure across AWS and Azure in support of production workloads.
* Operate and maintain Kubernetes clusters, including deploying and maintaining Helm charts for the services you support.
* Participate in on-call rotation, respond to incidents, and drive them to resolution within your area of ownership.
* Contribute to capacity planning, cost optimization, and resilience improvements for the systems you support.

Automation & Continuous Delivery:

* Build and maintain GitOps-based deployment pipelines using Argo CD/Argo Workflows, including rollout and promotion configuration across environments.
* Write and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, OpenTofu) for the infrastructure you own, following team module standards.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins, improving build/deploy automation and reliability.
* Support progressive delivery practices (blue-green/canary, automated rollback) for the services you support.

Reliability & Observability:

* Build and maintain Datadog dashboards, monitors, and alerts for the services you support, tuning alert thresholds to reduce noise.
* Contribute to defining SLIs/SLOs for your services and help track them over time.
* Participate in postmortems for incidents you're involved in, and follow through on assigned remediation items.

Collaboration & Mentorship:

* Partner with engineers across the SRE team and with product engineering teams to troubleshoot issues and improve system design.
* Share knowledge with and mentor less-experienced engineers on the team (CloudOps Engineer I III) on cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and CI/CD practices.
* Contribute to documentation, runbooks, and onboarding materials for the systems you support.

### **Required Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of experience in Cloud Operations, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineering roles.
* Hands-on experience with AWS — you can build, troubleshoot, and operate cloud infrastructure directly.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Helm — deploying, operating, and troubleshooting workloads in production clusters.
* Hands-on experience with Argo CD/Argo Workflows for GitOps-based continuous delivery.
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, OpenTofu).
* Hands-on experience with Jenkins and Rancher for CI/CD pipeline development and maintenance.
* Hands-on experience with Datadog (or equivalent observability platform), including building dashboards, monitors, and alerts.
* Experience participating in an on-call rotation and responding to production incidents.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across teams.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting payments, fuel/retail, or loyalty platforms, or other systems with PCI DSS or similar compliance obligations.
* Relevant certifications such as CKA/CKAD, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, or HashiCorp Terraform Associate.
* Experience with messaging systems (Kafka/SQS/SNS) and multi-region/multi-AZ resilience patterns.
* Prior experience mentoring junior engineers or leading small technical initiatives.

### **Behavioral Competencies:**

* Cultivates Innovation
* Decision Quality
* Manages Complexity
* Drives Results
* Business Insight

PDI is committed to offering a well-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career. This includes a competitive salary, market-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work-life balance with ample time off [time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. bd3d4179.description:
**Description**

Follow Zones, LLC on Twitter @Zones, and LinkedIn and Facebook.

Position Overview:

The Solution Architect – EMEA is responsible for designing innovative, scalable, and commercially viable IT solutions for enterprise customers across the EMEA region. Working closely with Sales, Delivery, Technology Partners, and Customers, this role drives solution design, presales strategy, proposal development, and customer presentations to help secure new business and accelerate growth.

* Strong analytical, organizational, and leadership skills

Zones offers a comprehensive Benefits package.
  
  
While we’re committed to providing top-tier solutions, we’re just as committed to supporting our own teams. Our team members enjoy a variety of comprehensive benefits, including Medical Insurance Coverage, Group Term Life and Personal Accident Cover to handle the uncertainties of life, flexible leave policy to balance their work life.

At Zones, work is more than a job – it's an exciting career immersed in an inventive, collaborative culture. If you’re interested in working on the cutting edge of IT innovation, sales, engineering, operations, administration, and more, Zones is the place for you!

Java 11/17/21+
  
Spring Boot

REST APIs
  
Microservices architecture
  
JPA / Hibernate

TypeScript
  
JavaScript

State management

Frontend testing frameworks

**Experience with modern cloud-native engineering practices:**  
AWS / Azure / GCP
  
Docker
  
Kubernetes
  
CI/CD
  
Git
  
Jenkins / GitHub Actions / GitLab CI / Azure DevOps
  
Infrastructure as Code
  
Observability and monitoring
  
Logging and distributed tracing
  
  
Experience deploying and operating microservices in a cloud environment is highly desirable.
  
  
8. Software Architecture
  
  
**Strong understanding of:**  
Microservices
  
Domain-Driven Design
  
SOLID principles
  
Design patterns
  
Event-driven architecture
  
Distributed systems
  
API-first architecture
  
  
Ability to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions and architecture.
  
  
Required Skills
  
Must Have
  
10–15+ years of software engineering experience.
  
Strong hands-on Java development experience.
  
Strong Spring Boot / Microservices experience.
  
Hands-on Full-Stack development experience.
  
Experience with React or Angular.
  
Strong knowledge of REST

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. d27a22e4.description:
NVIDIA is seeking a dynamic and experienced Generative AI Solution Architect with specialized expertise in training Large Language Models (LLMs) and Agentic AI . As a key member of our AI Solutions team, you will play a pivotal role in architecting and delivering cutting-edge solutions that leverage the power of NVIDIA's generative AI technologies. This position requires a deep understanding of language models, particularly LLMs, and a strong proficiency in designing and implementing agentic and RAG-based workflows.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Architect end-to-end generative AI solutions with a focus on LLMs, Agentic and RAG workflows.
* Collaborate closely with customers to understand their language-related business challenges and design tailored solutions.
* Collaborate with sales and business development teams to support pre-sales activities, including technical presentations and demonstrations of LLM and RAG capabilities.
* Work closely with NVIDIA engineering teams to provide feedback and contribute to the evolution of generative AI technologies.
* Engage directly with customers to understand their language-related requirements and challenges.
* Lead workshops and design sessions to define and refine generative AI solutions focused on LLMs and RAG workflows and lead the training and optimization of Large Language Models using NVIDIA’s hardware and software platforms.
* Implement strategies for efficient and effective training of LLMs to achieve optimal performance.
* Design and implement RAG-based workflows to enhance content generation and information retrieval.
* Work closely with customers to integrate RAG workflows into their applications and systems and stay abreast of the latest developments in language models and generative AI technologies.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance on best practices for training LLMs and implementing RAG-based solutions.

**What We Need To See**

* B.Tech ,Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent experience
* 8+ years of hands-on experience in a technical role, specifically focusing on generative AI, with a strong emphasis on training Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Proven track record of successfully deploying and optimizing LLM models for inference in production environments.
* In-depth understanding of state-of-the-art language models, including but not limited to GPT-3, BERT, or similar architectures.
* Expertise in training and fine-tuning LLMs using popular frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face Transformers.
* Proficiency in model deployment and optimization techniques for efficient inference on various hardware platforms, with a focus on GPUs.
* Strong knowledge of GPU cluster architecture and the ability to leverage parallel processing for accelerated model training and inference.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading workshops, training sessions, and presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Proven ability to optimize LLM models for inference speed, memory efficiency, and resource utilization.
* Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes) for scalable and efficient model deployment.
* Deep understanding of GPU cluster architecture, parallel computing, and distributed computing concepts.
* Hands-on experience with NVIDIA GPU technologies, and GPU cluster management and ability to design and implement scalable and efficient workflows for LLM training and inference on GPU clusters

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you!
