49770518.title: Architect - Infra
49770518.description:
**Overview**
Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment
  
  
Gathers customer/partner insights from a broad range of stakeholders as well as the main business sponsor to shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of projects. Identifies and evaluates industry trends (customer industry verticals, information technology [IT] industry). Adapts business models, plans, and solutions to insights.
  
  
Works with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach to determine if changes are needed to the business solution. Where the cost of change is accepted by the customer, shares this feedback with the project team and the broader account team to make the necessary adjustments using mechanisms such as updating the solution approach and projected costs in presales and change requests in delivery. Contributes to Microsoft-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.
  
  
Uses evidence-based approach to represent the customer/partner as a customer advocate and shares insights with Product Engineering teams and the business with a view to improving Microsoft technologies, products, services, and offerings such that they can better meet customer/partner needs across a territory.
  
  
Architecture Design and Deployment
  
  
Leverages a structured approach to Architecture Projects using existing methodologies (e.g., Waterfall, Agile, Iterative) that make use of existing reference architecture and established architectural styles and design patterns. Proposes and develops new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners. Builds and maintains an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to ensure the rationale for the business solution's Architecture is known and understood. 
  
  
Defines and documents the architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Leads complex cost-based and technology-based discussions to explain the Architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Uses a business-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer costs-savings over technical ease of execution. 
  
  
Collaborates with the Project Manager to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots, using enterprise architecture processes and ensuring quality control through peer review. Works with customers to understand and demonstrate business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realize.
  
  
Works with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Manages and resolves complex ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved. Maintains the requirements/constraints traceability matrix to prove that solution components have a rationale/justification for inclusion in the architecture of the business solution. Drives development and execution of test plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer. Where there are defects, works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Customer to redress or accept and document the status of the test results. 
  
  
Collaborates with the Account Team and/or Bid Team to understand the business solution/problem. Drives agreement, based on the customer’s priorities, requirements/constraints, approach, principles, concepts, and expectations. Builds and documents a realistically costed, advanced/complex Solution Approach with traceability of requirements, constraints, decisions, and tradeoffs that balances risk, technical credibility, and technical innovation to meet customer need, predominantly based on existing solution offerings and/or reference architecture. Jointly leads the implementation in close partnership with the Project Manager. Leads oversight and governance and establishment of quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Uses a cohesive build methodology with an agreed release schedule and timeline so the solution can be transitioned to live operations, leveraging solution expertise. Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre-sales value proposition. Works with the Project Manager to highlight where assumptions have proven false. Uses change requests to modify the Solution/project approach when needed. As needed, collaborates with subject matter experts to receive specialized advice that can help define the Solution and project approach and increase the time to value for the customer.
  
  
Anticipates and identifies scenarios that could slow or impede pre-sales/delivery. Orchestrates the broader Microsoft team to address technical blockers and works with account/project team to resolve non-technical issues. Reports significant problems to Microsoft management and resolves escalations when needed. Plans a way forward in complex and ambiguous situations with an innovative approach and durable design. Delegates and leverages specialist skills of others to drive technical alignment across internal/external teams. Coordinates disparate approaches into a single plan of action for complex scenarios.  
  
  
Works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Account Team to identify, categorize, and communicate business and technical risks. Defines risk mitigation activities that are foundational to the project plan. Defines risk contingency plans for invocation should the risk occur. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary. 
  
  
Practice Development
  
  
Generates new and/or improvements to existing intellectual property. Connects gaps and patterns across business and technology areas to drive changes. Identifies which ideas should be culled, with consideration for scale across customers. Drives the re-use of intellectual property and recommends practices in both pre-sales and delivery. Participates and contributes to internal/external communities. 
  
  
Trusted Advisor
  
  
Develops a network of internal/external relationships with senior-level decision makers to build influence in addressing problems/blockers and facilitating additional views on the matter of interest. Acts as an advisor to external stakeholders. Provides direction to facilitate relationships between others. Stays up to date on Microsoft’s technologies, products, and services in order to communicate Microsoft's mission, strategy, and capabilities. When appropriate, develops a strategic relationship with key stakeholders within the customer portfolio, often as part of a steering committee, to ensure service delivery is on track and major issues are being anticipated, identified, and managed.
  
  
Uses evidence-based arguments that articulate complex concepts in a simple manner to respectfully challenge Microsoft and customers/partners when a decision or course of action will not produce optimal results. Leverages strategic expertise to encourage alternative approaches where applicable. Serves as the "technical conscience" to challenge the status quo and unrealistic expectations. Proactively resolves conflicts and seeks resolution to balance the overall outcome. Drives consensus where possible and leads decisions to resolve conflict when needed.
  
  
Leads the adoption of Microsoft solutions technologies based on understanding of competitor solutions and how customer business value can be driven through Microsoft's offerings. Differentiates Microsoft's solutions in customer/partner conversations to influence the industry-wide direction for specific architecture(s).
  
  
Thought Leadership
  
  
Leads virtual teams around technologies and customer/partner challenges by sharing ideas, insight, and strategic, technical input with technical teams, internal communities across the field, and the larger virtual team across Microsoft using knowledge of Microsoft architectures and their context in the competitive landscape.
  
  
Participates in external architect community events (e.g., conferences, seminars, technical meetups, Webcasts, blogs, hackathons) and shares learnings with internal team. Acts a mentor to less experienced colleagues by educating them on technical and non-technical concepts and sharing best practices. Demonstrates deep industry knowledge and drives recognition for Microsoft solutions through presentations and engagements with external audiences.

0e918043.description:
**SAP Solution Architect**

The **Solution Architect** designs the overarching end-to-end business capabilities across the retail domain, orchestrating processes that span multiple modules in the planned SAP S/4 system.

* **Key Responsibilities:**
* **Blueprinting & Architecture:** Define, design, and maintain the global SAP target architecture. Ensure end-to-end process integration across critical business cycles, including Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), and Record-to-Report (R2R).
* **Cross-Module Integration:** Drive architectural alignment and seamless data flow between core modules, specifically SAP FI/CO, SD, ensuring zero siloed workflows.
* **Technology Modernization:** Lead the architectural strategy for legacy ERP migration to SAP S/4HANA, optimizing the use of SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) for cloud-native extensions.
* **Stakeholder Advisory:** Partner closely with executive business leaders, business analysts, and functional leads to translate complex business objectives into scalable, sustainable SAP solutions.
* **Governance & Standards:** Establish and enforce SAP development best practices, data governance frameworks, and clean-core principles to minimize custom ABAP technical debt.
* **Vendor & Partner Orchestration:** Collaborate with external system integrators, SAP professionals, and third-party vendors during large-scale deployment, testing, and hyper-care phases.
* **Architectural Orchestration:** Lead, mentor, and govern a team of dedicated SAP Solution Architects and/or Subject Matter Experts (System Engineers) across specialized domains (such as SD, FI/CO).
* **Cross-Functional Alignment:** Act as the ultimate escalation point and referee for cross-module integration disputes, ensuring that a decision made by the FI architect does not negatively impact the workflows of the SD architects**.**

**Functional & Technical Scope**

You will be expected to architect solutions that natively integrate the following domains:

* **Finance & Controlling (FI/CO):** New General Ledger, Asset Accounting, Accounts Payable/Receivable, Cost Center Accounting, Product Costing, and Profitability Analysis (CO-PA).
* **Supply Chain & Logistics (SD):** Inventory Management, Purchasing, Pricing Procedures, Logistics Execution, Delivery, and Billing.
* **Technical Foundation:** SAP Basis, ABAP extensibility optimization, SAP Security/GRC, and API-led integration via SAP BTP.

9a059f65.title: Application Security Architect
9a059f65.description:
**Job Title:** Application Security Architect  
 **Experience: 12+ Years**  
 **Location: Hyderabad (Hybrid)**

  

**Position Summary:**

We are looking for a hands-on \*\*Application Security Architect\*\* who combines strong software engineering skills with deep application security expertise. This is a generalist role you should be comfortable reading and writing production-quality code across multiple languages, and equally comfortable designing and running an AppSec program that spans SAST, DAST, and SCA tooling, secure architecture reviews, and developer enablementThis position will require occasional after-hours and weekend work. The selected candidate will be expected to attend work on a regular and predictable schedule in accordance with agency leave policy and perform other duties as assigned.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

- Design and drive the application security strategy across the SDLC from design reviews through CI/CD to production.

- Own and continuously tune \*\*SAST\*\* (e.g., Checkmarx, Fortify, Semgrep, CodeQL), \*\*DAST\*\* (e.g., Burp Suite Enterprise, OWASP ZAP, Invicti), and \*\*SCA\*\* (e.g., Snyk, Black Duck, Mend, Dependency-Track) tooling — integration, rule tuning, false-positive reduction, and coverage.

- Perform secure architecture and design reviews for new features, services, and major system changes.

- Read, write, and refactor code (not just review it) to build internal tooling, PoCs for vulnerabilities, custom scanners, and secure-by-default libraries/frameworks.

- Conduct manual code reviews and threat modeling for high-risk services, complementing automated tooling.

- Partner with engineering teams to remediate vulnerabilities, and act as a technical escalation point for security findings.

- Build and maintain CI/CD security gates (pre-commit hooks, pipeline scanning, break-the-build policies).

- Define and evangelize secure coding standards, guardrails, and reusable security patterns/libraries.

- Run or support penetration tests and coordinate remediation with engineering.

- Mentor developers and security champions; deliver secure coding training.

- Track and report AppSec metrics (vulnerability density, MTTR, tool coverage, false-positive rates) to leadership.

- Stay current on emerging threats (OWASP Top 10, CWE/SANS Top 25, supply chain attacks) and evolve the program accordingly.

**Required Skills**

\*\***Engineering foundation** (must-have — this is a generalist coding role, not a pure GRC/tooling role): \*\*

- Strong hands-on software development experience in at least one backend language (e.g., Java, Python, Go, Node.js, C#) and working familiarity with others.

- Comfortable reading and writing code across the stack — APIs, web front ends, mobile, or infrastructure-as-code, as relevant to your environment.

- Solid understanding of software design patterns, frameworks, and modern CI/CD pipelines.

\*\***Application security expertise**: \*\*

- Deep, practical experience with \*\*SAST\*\*, \*\*DAST\*\*, and \*\*SCA\*\* tools — selection, deployment, tuning, and interpreting results (not just running scans).

- Strong grasp of OWASP Top 10, OWASP ASVS, CWE/SANS Top 25, and secure design principles (authN/authZ, cryptography, input validation, session management).

- Experience with threat modeling methodologies (STRIDE, PASTA, or similar).

- Familiarity with container/cloud security (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/Azure/GCP security services) is a plus.

- Understanding of software supply chain security (SBOM, dependency risk, artifact signing).

- Experience building custom security tooling or writing SAST/DAST rules.

- Exposure to regulated industries (BFSI, healthcare) or compliance frameworks (PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2).

addfce53.title: Security Architect — Microsoft Security Platform
addfce53.description:
Job Description
  

**Security Architect — Microsoft Security Platform**

  

**Practice**

Cyber Security, Avanade India

**Location**

Bengaluru / Delhi NCR (Hybrid)

  

**Experience**

12–14 years in the cyber security domain, with current, hands-on design and implementation experience across the Microsoft security platform — Microsoft Sentinel, Defender, Entra ID, Intune and Purview

  

**Role Summary**

Avanade India’s Cyber Security practice is looking for a Security Architect with strong hands-on experience across the Microsoft security estate. This is a client-facing role for someone who can design a Sentinel and Defender architecture, work alongside a client SOC team on the detail, and present the design credibly to senior client stakeholders.

The emphasis is on breadth across the Microsoft security platform — threat protection, cloud security, identity and data security — and the ability to design them as one integrated architecture rather than a set of separately deployed products. You will lead the security workstream on client engagements, support pursuits as the security SME, and contribute to the practice’s standards and reusable IP.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the security architecture for client engagements — target-state design, Zero Trust design, control mapping and a prioritised security roadmap aligned to the client’s risk profile.

* Design and implement Microsoft Sentinel: workspace and tenant design, ingestion strategy, log tiering and cost optimisation, detection engineering in KQL, and SOAR playbooks.

* Support migrations from legacy SIEM platforms (Splunk, QRadar, ArcSight and similar) to Microsoft Sentinel — content and use-case migration, parallel running and validation.

* Design across Microsoft Defender XDR — Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps — covering deployment architecture, policy design, tuning and incident investigation.

* Design cloud posture and workload security with Defender for Cloud — CSPM and CWPP, secure score improvement and regulatory compliance dashboards.

* Architect identity security on Entra ID: conditional access design, Privileged Identity Management, identity governance, and passwordless and phishing-resistant authentication.

* Design endpoint security through Intune — security baselines, attack surface reduction and compliance policies — integrated with Defender for Endpoint.

* Design Microsoft Purview solutions for data security: information protection and sensitivity labelling, and DLP.

* Run security assessments and maturity reviews — gap analysis against NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS and Microsoft Zero Trust maturity, with prioritised remediation roadmaps.

* Contribute to detection strategy and SOC ways of working — use-case catalogues, detection engineering lifecycle and incident response runbooks.

* Advise on securing AI adoption — Copilot readiness and oversharing remediation, and the data security controls that make AI deployment defensible.

* Align security design to regulatory and data protection requirements — India’s DPDP Act, GDPR, and sector guidance such as RBI, SEBI or IRDAI where applicable.

* Support security solutioning on pursuits — workshops, solution architecture, estimation and proposal content.

Contribute to practice IP — reference architectures, deployment accelerators and detection content — and mentor security consultants and analysts.  

  

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 12–14 years in cyber security across architecture, engineering, consulting or security operations, with a substantial recent focus on the Microsoft security platform.

* Hands-on design and implementation experience across Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, Defender for Cloud, Entra ID and Intune, with working knowledge of Purview.

* Strong Microsoft Sentinel depth: ingestion and cost architecture, KQL proficiency, detection engineering and automation with Logic Apps.

* Design and deployment experience across the Defender suite, including policy and exclusion strategy and alert tuning.

* Purview experience across information protection and DLP, including classification and labelling strategy.

* Solid identity security background: Entra ID architecture, conditional access, privileged access and hybrid identity.

* Working knowledge of Azure platform security — network security, Key Vault, encryption, and how platform design affects security posture.

* Practical command of security frameworks and standards: NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, MITRE ATT&CK and Zero Trust reference models.

* Experience leading security assessments and producing prioritised, client-ready roadmaps.

* Incident response and threat landscape awareness — able to reason about attacker behaviour, not only about product configuration.

* Strong client-facing consulting skills, including senior stakeholder engagement and contribution to pre-sales solutioning.

* Clear technical writing — architecture documents, assessment reports and runbooks at client-ready quality.

  
Qualification
  

**Preferred / Good to Have**

* Microsoft certifications: SC-100, SC-200, SC-300, SC-400 or AZ-500; industry certifications such as CISSP or CISM.

* Experience with data protection and regulatory requirements applicable to Indian and global clients.

* Automation and IaC for security deployment — PowerShell, Logic Apps, Bicep or Terraform for repeatable security configuration.

* Multi-cloud security exposure (AWS, GCP) and integration of third-party tooling into Sentinel.

* Experience supporting MDR or managed security services.

* Experience in regulated industries — BFSI, healthcare, energy or public sector.

* Experience in a global delivery / SI or Microsoft partner environment with distributed teams.

* Experience mentoring junior security consultants and analysts.

* Experience with event-driven architectures, message queues, or streaming systems

**Description**
Amazon Operations Infrastructure Solutions (OIS) is seeking an experienced Sr Technical Infrastructure Program Manager (TIPM) for our team. Amazon teams and systems create a complex ecosystem with coordination challenges for large initiatives. As the Sr TIPM of Engineering, you will need to coordinate across this network of teams and own delivery of cross organization initiatives. Using your technical background, you will need to understand implementation challenges of each organization and team, and find solutions while also earning trust with senior management to drive adoption from the top down.
  
  
**A Successful Candidate Will Also Demonstrate**

* High attention to detail
* Ability to think strategically and execute methodically
* Demonstrated ability to influence management
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment where continuous innovation is desired
* Committed to learning and expanding professional and technical knowledge
* Demonstrated analytical and quantitative skills and ability to use hard data and metrics to back up assumptions and develop business cases
* Ability to clearly communicate data insights to others
* Willingness to roll up your sleeves and do whatever is necessary; owner mentality
* Demonstrated ability to dive deep in understanding the product, our business, and the market landscape

Key job responsibilities
  
  
**In This Role**

* You manage complex infrastructure builds, delivering critical solutions, significant improvements, new mechanisms, or deprecating processes that are no longer needed. These efforts require you to work with multiple teams in and/or across organizations.
* You are accountable for the overall strategy of a large program. You successfully manage all stages (from concept to delivery). Your program meets business goals and/or shows measurable improvements in your customer’s experience, business or employee efficiency or execution, compliance adherence, financial or other metrics, etc.
* You understand the interdependencies and functionality of the technologies you work with (e.g. customer requirements, deployment constraints, design limitations, operational support requirements). You influence team priorities and business strategy through data-supported contributions. You are able to make a case for project priorities, resource allocation, and/or appropriate program adoption, to achieve a desired business outcome, resolve a technical deficiency, or unblock delivery.
* You communicate ideas effectively, verbally and in writing, to a wide range of audiences including Directors and VPs. You foster a constructive dialogue, harmonize discordant views, and lead the resolution of contentious issues (build consensus). You partner successfully with customers, stakeholders, and engineering teams.
* Your program management practices set a great example to others. You routinely and efficiently deliver the right things. You define clear goals and objectives. You drive crisp decisions in your program area about what projects move forward and in what priority order. You proactively identify risks and bring them to the attention of your team and stakeholders with plans for mitigation before they become roadblocks.
* You are a simplifier. You judiciously add, refine, and remove procedures. By applying project management best practices, you increase the productivity and effectiveness of the teams you work with.
* You actively participate in the hiring process as well as mentor others - improving their skills and ability to get things done.

A day in the life
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.
  
  
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment.
  
  
If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you!
  
  
At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!
  
  
**About The Team**
This role is specifically to manage cross cutting program for the Amazon Robotics/AFT/OpsTechIT organizations. It is a large multi-year initiative, involving 30+ teams, and with significant technical complexity and visibility.

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
**Overview**
The Security Solutions Data Science organization is looking for an experienced Technical Program Manager with an understanding of data science who is eager to take on the responsibility of managing a wide variety of data science projects. The person in this role will join a team of leading edge data scientists who are not just building models, but are working to solve fraud related problems for our customers through AI as a foundation for new product offerings.
  
  
Role
  
  
The Technical Program Manager will interact with data scientists, product managers, engineers, and senior leaders across partner teams in the organization to deliver complex projects. You will define roadmap deliverables, develop execution plans, align dependencies, track progress, anticipate risks, provide escalation management, make sound trade-off decisions, and translate technical expressions into business terminology. The ideal candidate is passionate about the customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset. You are expected to be detail-oriented, with a solid technical background and excellent problem-solving skills.
  
  
All staff at Mastercard are expected to demonstrate 'Mastercard Way' cultural values every day - own it, simplify it, sense of urgency, thoughtful risk-taking, unlock potential, and be inclusive – with a relentless focus on our customers.
  
  
As a Senior Technical Program Manager for data science, you are expected to perform the following general responsibilities:
  
  

* Primary liaison between product and data science, managing day-to-day planning and execution of data science projects through the entire engagement process, from business understanding through model deployment and monitoring
* Looked to as first point of contact for your teams or business line/service and the single source of truth for status, providing the correct information and associated data about the state of the project to the right audience at the right time with the right focus
* Build strong partnerships with product and technology teams and align esnure alignment with data science efforts
* Translate technical approaches and outcomes into business language
* Understands the business strategy and design approaches within product, program, or domain with depth to be credible and influential with teams they work with
* Clearly articulate scope, timelines, dependencies, owners, actions, risks, and mitigations. Report progress to teams and senior leadership in regular cadence, potentially representing segments of or the entire program
* Work with data scientists and engineering teams to build/improve ways of working and identify and mitigate risks or issues that may impact the plan
* Conducts meaningful retrospectives, creates action plans to implement changes at the team level

**All About You**
It is not expected that any single candidate would have expertise across all these areas.
  
  

* Experience with project management, operating autonomously across multiple teams, with demonstrated critical thinking, and thought leadership
* Demonstrated experience breaking down problems, organizing work, planning, and building
* Help product, data science and engineering teams make trade-off decisions by considering all data including business goals, technical platform strategy, customer experience and maintainability. Identify blocking issues and manage their resolution
* Proven track record of data-driven decision making and applying continuous improvement methodologies across teams
* Demonstrated experience building relationships, partnering with and influencing dependent teams while commanding the respect of the individuals you work with across the organization
* Excellent organization, interpersonal, administrative and problem solving skills
* Strong communication skills at all levels of the organization
* Capable of working independently but with a collaborative nature.
* Ability to navigate a matrix organization.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

2c665ca0.title: Senior Program Manager
2c665ca0.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.
  
  
**About Us**
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
  
  
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
  
  
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
  
  
**About The Role**
The mission of the Engineering Program Management Office (PMO) is to implement program and project management methodologies that enable Fivetran to deliver complex products and initiatives on time and within expectations. In addition, the Engineering PMO serves as the subject-matter expert body on project and program management standards, directing a department-wide approach to program delivery and communication. You will help plan, track, and execute the company's most critical and cross-cutting Product and Engineering objectives. You will be responsible for leading cross-functional teams, managing complex programs and projects, and ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality solutions that meet our customers' needs. You will communicate and work in close collaboration with partners across the engineering team and other business partners to achieve this vision.
  
  
This is a full-time position based out of our Bangalore Office, India.
  
  
**Technologies you will use:**

* G Suite, AI LLM and Agents (Claude Code, Gemini, ChatGPT, and similar), Jira, Looker, Graphana, Lucid Charts, Workday, Sigma, Figma, BigQuery, Custom Apps.

**What You’ll Do:**
**Program/Project Management**

* Manage key engineering projects, and/or programs, or initiatives from initiation to closing.
* Provide regular status updates on a variety of internal channels to all levels of the organization.
* Define program charters, plans, and schedules. Drive Program execution.
* Drive Product representatives in providing timely direction and requirements.
* Lead internal cross-functional teams in engineering and validation activities.
* Ensure tight inter-team coordination and communication.
* Digest, understand, and communicate complex, technical/engineering issues.
* Identify and resolve conflicts or issues quickly, efficiently, and effectively.
* Surface and mitigate risks or defects, and lead technical task forces to ensure proper risk responses or issue resolution.
* Manage interdependencies across multiple engineering disciplines and stakeholders, including platform, SRE, & QA.
* Develop creative solutions, remove obstacles, and redefine approaches to balance cost, quality, and delivery priorities.
* Work closely with product management, data analytics, enablement & support.
* Define and own specific program metrics and objectives.
* Track and report on PMO KPIs.

**Process Improvement**

* Act as a role model for project/program management processes.
* Surface feedback and enhancement to project/program management processes.
* Align stakeholders and team members towards project/program management best practices.

**Skills We’re Looking For:**

* 1+ years of experience in a technical position (software engineer, QE/QA, platform engineer, etc.).
* Software project management experience is a strong plus.
* 4+ years of experience in technical project/program management.
* Agile and waterfall project/program management experience.
* Familiarity with project management tools like Jira.
* Can lead large and complex initiatives with minimal oversight.
* Can introduce structure and order in volatile conditions.
* Can clarify vague goals and requirements.
* AI LLMs and AI Agents usage proficiency.
* AI skills development.
* In-depth knowledge of the technologies and methodologies used in program management.
* Ability to work directly with senior leadership on programs, including leading R&D-wide (engineering, product, design, security) initiatives from start to finish.
* You can facilitate discussions with engineering subject-matter experts on topics such as System Design, Data Architecture, Infrastructure Management (including cost management), and Quality.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills with the ability to interact and collaborate with technical and non-technical groups at all levels.
* A data-driven and action-oriented mindset with excellent planning, analytical, problem-solving, project/program management, organizational, and leadership skills.
* Proficient in addressing technical issues and providing effective mitigation plans.
* Can align team members to program goals and objectives.
* Demonstrates integrity, upholding professional codes of conduct.

**(Optional) Bonus Skills**

* Start-up experience a strong plus
* PMP certification is a plus
* Familiarity with the following technologies is a plus: Cloud service providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), ETL or ELT, modern data stack.

**Perks And Benefits**
100% employer-paid medical insurance- Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
- RSU stock grants\*
- Professional development and training opportunities
- Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
- Monthly cell phone stipend
- Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.
\*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information
  
  
*Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.*
We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.
  
  
Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

Combining an intuitive platform, AI-powered capabilities, trusted content, expert services, and a broad ecosystem of integrations, Litmos helps organizations accelerate workforce productivity, improve customer adoption and retention, enable high-performing partners, and reduce organizational risk through continuous learning.

This is a cross-cutting role: you'll be the connective tissue between team-level execution and organizational delivery goals, working daily with Technical Owners, Product Owners, and senior developers across India, the US, the UK, and Australia.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the delivery cadence across engineering teams, tracking sprint commitments, velocity, cycle time, and commitment reliability.
* Facilitate cross-team dependency management and ensure shared resources are allocated effectively.
* Run program-level ceremonies including cross-team standups, delivery reviews, and quarterly planning coordination.
* Build and maintain delivery dashboards and reporting for engineering leadership.
* Serve as the senior on-the-ground leader in Pune, working alongside the Office Manager and local HR representative on onboarding, retention, engagement, and hiring logistics.
* Act as an escalation point for Pune-based staff on operational or interpersonal matters.
* Support SDLC evolution (Scrum, ShapeUp) and champion AI-assisted development tools (Claude, Copilot) across teams.

* Maintain structured communication rhythms across US, UK, and AU timezones.

**Required**

* Experience coordinating delivery across 5+ concurrent engineering teams.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery frameworks with practical experience improving delivery performance.
* Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal) with the ability to work effectively across multiple timezones.
* Experience in distributed, multi-timezone engineering organizations.
* Experience partnering with HR on people operations or onboarding.

**Preferred**

* Experience in a product company that transitioned from contractors to FTEs.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar tools.

**Why UKG**
At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. The role of the Services Architect is responsible for consulting with clients to analyze and understand the client's business needs and create a services solution to meet those requirements. This position will be the focal point for effective communications with the client/prospect for the development of a services solution.
  
  
The Services Architect is expected to maintain a thorough knowledge of UKG’s services and practices and work with each service line to create and coordinate the proposed solution and pricing. The Services Architect will be responsible for driving revenue by evaluating, product positioning, and selling the optimal services components for the client. The Services Architect will be the single point of contact for sales and clients for services opportunities.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Partner with the UKG Sales organization and designated Services Architects line of business to pursue and close services opportunities
* Provide a single point of contact to Sales and Services Delivery for services opportunities
* Develop an understanding of each target customer’s business, operations, and industry trends
* Understand the customer’s strategic business and technology goals and create the proposed service approach and solution
* Drive the sales process to completion coordinating all Services resources and documentation such as proposals, SOW’s, RFP responses, etc
* Track critical sales and pipeline data on opportunities using existing systems
* Maintain a pipeline and communicate it to Strategist, Sales and Services Delivery management
* Contribute to the improved efficiency of the sales function by participating in the development and deployment of appropriate services sales tools/templates
* Grow services revenue by interacting with all levels of customer management and proposing solutions that provide business benefit
* Participate in Rapid Improvement Team Involvement

* 3-5+ years in a professional services role, ideally 3+ years in application software implementation and/or services sales
* Advanced knowledge and understanding of HCM, WFM, Scheduling, Leave Management, or similar domain product/systems required
* Previous experience with customer presentations, developing SOW’s, responding to RFP’s, estimating projects, and negotiating contracts
* Ability to develop and manage complex Services solutions for small to medium business to Enterprise level organizations
* Well versed in Launch implementation methodology with experience defining project requirements, managing project engagements, developing project plans, etc
* Ability to travel up to 25% as needed

* Develop good working relationships with staff in Services and Sales organizations
* Ability to be engaged in the art of consultative selling and negotiating techniques
* Intermediate presentation skills with the ability to effectively articulate the services value proposition as part of the overall business solution
* Ability to effectively communicate and negotiate with C-Level executives in an “influence without authority” role
* Understands the impact and implications of political, social, economic, technological, and competitive trends on UKG and customer organizations
* Working knowledge of nuances of the small to medium business to Enterprise-level business space preferred

UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. We are seeking an experienced
**Presales Architect - Applications**
with deep expertise in
**enterprise data architecture and on-premises data platforms**
to support complex sales engagements.
  
  
This role focuses on designing
**scalable, secure, and high-performance data solutions within traditional enterprise environments**
, enabling organizations to modernize legacy systems, improve data governance, and enhance analytics capabilities.
  
  
You will partner with sales, delivery, and customer stakeholders to shape data strategies, build compelling proposals, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Solution Architecture & Design
* Lead discovery sessions to assess existing enterprise data ecosystems, legacy platforms, and business requirements
* Design end-to-end data architectures including:

+ Enterprise Data Warehouses (EDW)
+ Operational Data Stores (ODS)
+ Data marts and reporting systems
+ Batch and near real-time data integration

* Ensure architectures meet requirements for performance, scalability, high availability, and disaster recovery

+ Hardware (servers, storage, networking)
+ Software licensing (databases, ETL, BI tools)
+ Data processing and integration workloads
+ Ongoing operations and support

* Build bottom-up estimates using:

+ Data volumes and growth projections
+ Workload and performance requirements

* Conduct ROI and TCO analysis for:

+ Legacy modernization initiatives
+ Platform consolidation and optimization

* Validate cost assumptions with delivery and finance teams

+ Data architecture diagrams
+ Data flow and integration patterns
+ Implementation roadmaps and migration plans
+ Resource planning and timelines
+ Risk mitigation strategies and governance models

* Clearly articulate business value including:

+ Improved data quality and reliability
+ Faster reporting and analytics
+ Operational efficiency and cost savings

+ Accelerate documentation
+ Improve clarity and structure of proposals
+ Synthesize complex requirements

+ Legacy data warehouse modernization
+ Data platform consolidation
+ ETL optimization and re-engineering
+ Data archival and lifecycle management

+ Replatforming to modern database systems
+ Data model redesign (dimensional, normalized, data vault)

* Enable capabilities for:

+ Near real-time data availability
+ Improved reporting performance
+ Better data accessibility

* Design and implement frameworks for:

+ Data governance and stewardship
+ Data quality management
+ Metadata management and lineage

* Ensure compliance with enterprise security standards:

+ Role-based access control
+ Data masking and encryption
+ Regulatory compliance requirements

* Develop transition documents and implementation playbooks
* Support project kickoffs and early delivery alignment
* Define SLAs, KPIs, and operational metrics

Capture feedback to improve solution quality and reusability

BA/BS degree and 10+ years’ relevant experience OR equivalent combination of education and experience
  
  
Master’s degree preferred.
  
  
**Experience**

* 8–12 years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or presales consulting
* Minimum 5 years focused on enterprise data platforms in on-premises environments
* Proven track record in:

+ Designing enterprise data solutions
+ Supporting and influencing large deals
+ Building cost models and ROI justifications

* Experience in RFP responses and technical proposal development

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong experience with enterprise database platforms:

+ Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, Teradata, or similar

* Deep understanding of:

+ Data warehousing concepts (EDW, ODS, data marts)
+ Data modeling techniques (dimensional, normalized, data vault)

* Hands-on experience with:

+ ETL/ELT tools (Informatica, DataStage, SSIS, etc.)
+ Batch and near real-time data integration

* Knowledge of:

+ Data governance, metadata, and data quality tools
+ Performance tuning and query optimization

* Experience with:

+ High availability, backup, and disaster recovery strategies

* Familiarity with BI/reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau, Cognos, etc.)
* Proficiency in using GenAI tools for presales productivity and documentation

**Business & Soft Skills**

* Strong ability to translate data architecture into business value
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Consultative approach to discovery and problem-solving
* Ability to manage multiple presales opportunities
* Strong collaboration across cross-functional teams
* Financial acumen in cost modeling and ROI analysis

**Certifications & Nice-to-Haves**

* Knowledge of frameworks such as DAMA-DMBOK
* Experience in system integrators or managed services environments
* Familiarity with MPP or appliance-based data systems (e.g., Teradata, Netezza)

**Success Metrics**

* Quality and scalability of architecture designs
* Customer satisfaction and successful delivery alignment
* Reusability of solution frameworks and assets

In this role you will apply your management and leadership capabilities to successfully execute project plans, proactively identify and manage risks, resolve issues, escalate when appropriate, and drive projects to successful completion, while exceeding customer expectation
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As an experienced technology program/project manager, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Delivering cloud migration or implementation projects/workstreams with guidance from senior team members
* Developing knowledge of AWS services, architectures, and best practices; learning to apply them in customer engagements
* Bridging business requirements with technical solutions, facilitating engineering discussions and ensuring alignment with customer business outcomes
* Distilling customer needs into clear technical requirements and map them to business outcomes
* Decomposing technical problems into actionable, deliverable solutions
* Creating and evolving team and engagement documentation; contributing to operational excellence (status updates, timesheets, reports)
* Learning to foresee, manage, and escalate engagement risks and issues to internal stakeholders

A day in the life
  
  
You might start your morning reviewing project dashboards and preparing a status update for a customer steering committee. By mid-morning, you are facilitating a sprint planning session with your delivery team, helping to clarify priorities and remove blockers. After lunch, you join a risk review with your AWS leadership to discuss an emerging scope question and propose a path forward. Later, you collaborate with a senior engagement manager to refine a delivery playbook that your team can reuse on future engagements. Throughout, you are sharpening your cloud knowledge and building the relationships that keep projects moving.
  
  
**About The Team**

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Effective stakeholder and client management skills
* Strong architecture and technical documentation expertise
* Presentation and solution demonstration skills

* Self-motivated and proactive attitude
* Ability to lead architecture reviews and design workshops
* Experience driving Proof of Concepts (POCs) and innovation initiatives
* Strong decision-making and technical leadership capabilities
* Ability to work across global and cross-functional teams

* Extensive hands-on experience with Google Apigee (Apigee X and/or Apigee Hybrid)
* Strong expertise in Kubernetes operations and platform architecture
* Experience designing and implementing cloud-native solutions on GCP, AWS, or Azure
* Strong understanding of cloud networking, security, IAM, and infrastructure services
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform or equivalent tools

* Ability to drive platform modernization, migration, and transformation initiatives

* Relevant cloud, Kubernetes, or Apigee certifications are preferred

**Additionally, Good To Have**

* Experience with GitOps tools such as ArgoCD, Flux CD, Helm, and Kustomize.
* Experience with security scanning and vulnerability management tools.
* API Developer Portal, API Monetization, and API Analytics expertise.

+ Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect
+ Google Apigee API Engineer Certification

**Ideally, You Will Also Have**

* Self-motivator and result oriented to complete task as per timelines
* Must have good analytical and problem-solving skills
* Good written/Verbal Communication, Presentation, Interactive skills with team across geography.

**What We Look For**

c79c2b26.description:
**Role description**

***Who we are:***

At UST, we help the world’s best organizations grow and succeed through transformation. Bringing together the right talent, tools, and ideas, we work with our client to co-create lasting change. Together, with over 30,000 employees in 30+ countries, we build for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at .

**Summary:**

We are seeking an experienced **AI Solution / Enterprise Architect** to lead the architectural transformation of enterprise software delivery through **AI, Generative AI, and Agentic AI**. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in **Solution/Enterprise Architecture**, hands-on experience with **GenAI and AI agents**, and a proven background in **AI-led SDLC transformation and full-stack modernization**.

This role will define the technical foundation for an AI-native operating model, identify and resolve architectural gaps across integration, orchestration, tooling, security, and governance, and guide Solution Architects toward independent, AI-native architectural decision-making.

  

**The Opportunity:**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the architectural dimension of AI-led SDLC transformation across enterprise engagements.
* Identify and resolve architecture gaps across integration, orchestration, AI tooling, APIs, cloud platforms, security, and DevOps.
* Design the technical foundation required to support Agentic AI and AI-native delivery models.
* Review and validate AI-generated architecture, solution designs, code, and technical outputs.
* Define and govern Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs), AI security guardrails, access-control boundaries, and compliance standards.
* Develop and maintain a Model Usage Matrix, mapping AI agent tasks to appropriate LLMs based on capability, cost, performance, security, and compliance.
* Design data models, ontologies, and machine-readable constraint schemas to govern AI agent behavior.
* Provide architectural leadership and coach Solution Architects in AI-native architecture, NFR design, security, and guardrail implementation.
* Partner with AI Technical Project Managers, AI Engineers, engineering teams, QA, and DevOps throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
* Drive enterprise-wide adoption of AI/GenAI engineering practices and Agentic AI solutions.
* Lead modernization initiatives spanning architecture, application development, cloud, QA, CI/CD, DevSecOps, and observability.
  

**What you need:**  
**Required Skills:**

* 8+ years of strong Solution Architecture / Enterprise Architecture experience, with demonstrated ownership of enterprise-level architecture decisions.
* 2+ years of hands-on AI, Generative AI, and Agentic AI experience, including practical implementation of AI-driven solutions.
* Hands-on experience with AI-led SDLC transformation, including AI-assisted architecture, development, testing, and engineering workflows.
* Experience with GenAI coding assistants and AI development tools such as Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and OpenAI Codex.
* Hands-on exposure to Agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or OpenAI Agents SDK.
* Strong expertise in application architecture, API/integration architecture, cloud, microservices, DevOps/DevSecOps, and security.
* Strong full-stack modernization background with proficiency in Java, Python, or equivalent enterprise technology stacks.
* Experience defining NFRs, AI security guardrails, access controls, governance standards, and responsible AI boundaries.
* Experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and observability.
* Strong understanding of data modeling, ontology design, and machine-readable constraint schemas.
* Proven ability to lead architects, influence engineering teams, and drive enterprise-wide AI adoption.
  

**Desired Skills:**

* Experience within BFSI or Healthcare domains.

* Experience evaluating and selecting LLMs based on capability, cost, security, and regulatory/compliance requirements.

* Exposure to enterprise-scale AI governance and Responsible AI practices.

* Experience modernizing large-scale legacy or full-stack applications using cloud-native and AI-enabled engineering approaches.

* Ability to work across architecture, software engineering, QA, DevOps, security, and AI engineering rather than operating in a design-only architecture role.

**Qualification:**

* **Bachelor’s or Master’s degree** in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  

***What we believe****:*

*We’re proud to embrace the same values that have shaped UST since the beginning. Since day one, we’ve been building enduring relationships and a culture of integrity. And today, it's those same values that are inspiring us to encourage innovation from everyone, to champion diversity and inclusion and to place people at the centre of everything we do.*

*We will listen, learn, be empathetic and help selflessly in our interactions with everyone.*

  

***Humanity:***

*Through business, we will better the lives of those less fortunate than ourselves.*

  

***Integrity:***

*We honour our commitments and act with responsibility in all our relationships.*

*All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, colour, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law.*

* *To support and promote the values of UST.*

* *Comply with all Company policies and procedures*

 **Skills**

Agentic AI, Data Modeling, Generative AI

354f7d55.description:
Position Description
  
  
Company Profile:
  
  
Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end-to-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.
  
  
Position: Manager Consulting Delivery- Technical Manager Delivery - AI Solutions / Platform(Gen AI / LLM, RAG, Agentic AI)
  
  
Experience: 12+Years
  
  
Category: Software Development/ Engineering
  
  
Shift: 12:00 PM-9.30 PM
  
  
Location: Bangalore/Pune
  
  
Position ID: J1026-0360
  
  
Employment Type: Full Time
  
  
Education Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 12 years of relevant experience.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Technical Manager - Delivery to lead engineering delivery for enterprise AI solutions and reusable AI platform capabilities. The role combines strong technical leadership with delivery and people management. The candidate will guide developers, AI engineers, QA and DevOps engineers; challenge architecture and design decisions; drive engineering quality, security, scalability and production readiness; and ensure predictable delivery of business outcomes.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have a strong application engineering foundation in Java and/or Python, APIs, microservices and cloud-native platforms, together with practical experience delivering Generative AI solutions using LLMs, RAG and agentic AI patterns. The role does not require an AI research background; the emphasis is enterprise AI application engineering and technical delivery leadership.
  
  
Your future duties and responsibilities
  
  
Technical & Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Lead end-to-end technical delivery of enterprise AI solutions, GenAI applications and reusable AI platform capabilities from design through production.
* Provide technical direction and review solution architecture, detailed design, APIs, integration patterns, code quality, performance, scalability and security.
* Guide implementation of LLM-based solutions including RAG, agentic workflows, tool calling, orchestration, prompt engineering and enterprise integrations.
* Own sprint and release planning, estimation, resource allocation, technical dependencies, risks, quality and delivery commitments.
* Drive production readiness, incident resolution, root-cause analysis, performance optimization and continuous improvement of AI services and platforms.

Team Engagement & People Leadership
  
  

* Lead, mentor and engage cross-functional teams comprising AI/application developers, technical leads, QA and DevOps engineers.
* Build a strong engineering culture focused on collaboration, ownership, innovation, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
* Conduct regular team connect sessions, 1:1s and feedback discussions; identify engagement risks, impediments and actions to improve team effectiveness.
* Drive hiring, onboarding, career development, performance management, succession planning and targeted upskilling in AI engineering and modern development practices.
* Identify skill gaps and create technical learning plans, communities of practice and opportunities for team members to contribute to reusable AI assets.

Operations & Engineering Management
  
  

* Own delivery operations for the technical organization, with accountability for revenue, gross margin, net margin, cost, utilization and overall delivery health.
* Track actuals versus plan for revenue, gross margin and net margin; identify variances early and drive corrective actions with delivery and leadership teams.
* Prepare revenue and resource forecasts, including capacity planning, demand pipeline, ramp-up/ramp-down plans, hiring needs and allocation of technical resources across engagements.
* Monitor team utilization and bench levels, balancing billable delivery, platform investments, production support, technical debt and capability development.
* Drive productivity and engineering efficiency through automation, AI-enabled development, reuse of platform capabilities and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Establish and review operational KPIs covering revenue attainment, margin performance, utilization, productivity, delivery predictability, quality, automation, incidents and customer commitments.
* Lead operational governance including monthly/quarterly business reviews, financial reviews, resource reviews, risk and dependency reviews, and action tracking.
* Partner with account, finance, sales and delivery leadership on forecasting, financial planning, staffing decisions, pricing inputs and opportunities to improve delivery economics.

AI Engineering & Quality
  
  

* Establish AI quality and reliability practices covering evaluation, grounding, hallucination reduction, guardrails, latency, cost, monitoring and human-in-the-loop controls where appropriate.
* Promote AI-enabled software development practices using coding assistants/agents for development, testing, code review and engineering productivity, with appropriate governance.

Stakeholder & Cross-functional Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects and business stakeholders to translate business problems into scalable technical solutions.
* Communicate technical risks, trade-offs, delivery status and operational performance clearly to leadership and non-technical stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
Must to Have Skills:
  
  
12+ years of software engineering experience with significant technical leadership and delivery management responsibility.
  
  

* Recent practical experience delivering enterprise GenAI/AI applications or platforms.
* Strong understanding of LLM application patterns: prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector search/vector databases and model evaluation.
* Understanding of agentic AI concepts including agents, tool/function calling, workflow orchestration, state/memory and human-in-the-loop patterns.
* Strong backend engineering experience in Java/Spring Boot and/or Python/FastAPI, with REST APIs, microservices and distributed application architecture.
* Experience designing or managing reusable platform services and enterprise integrations rather than only standalone AI proofs of concept.
* Cloud-native engineering experience on Azure, AWS or GCP, with Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift.
* Strong DevOps engineering knowledge including Git, CI/CD, automated testing, release management and environment management.
* Understanding of LLMOps/MLOps practices including prompt/model configuration versioning, evaluation, monitoring, observability and controlled deployment.
* Strong understanding of enterprise security including authentication/authorization, secrets management, data privacy, secure API integration and responsible AI controls.
* Proven experience managing developers, QA and DevOps engineers and driving engineering standards, technical reviews and production readiness.
* Strong Agile delivery, estimation, planning, risk/dependency management and stakeholder communication skills.
* Demonstrated experience using or enabling AI-assisted development tools responsibly across the software development lifecycle.

Good to have skills-
  
  

* NET; LangChain; LangGraph; Spring AI; Semantic Kernel; MCP; Kubernetes/OpenShift; Azure/AWS/GCP; LLMOps/MLOps; AI Evaluation & Observability; Guardrails; Vector Databases & Embeddings; DevOps/CI-CD; Healthcare domain exposure

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**
Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…
  
  
You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.
  
  
Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.
  
  
You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
  
  
That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.
  
  
Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.
