9e9e4506.title: Pre-sales Techno-functional Consultant (FCC & GRC)
9e9e4506.description:
Sciente is a Singapore-headquartered specialist BFSI technology and AI/data consulting firm, with offices across Singapore, Malaysia, India, and the USA. We help banks, insurers, and financial services firms modernize through AI-driven governance, risk and compliance (GRC), data intelligentisation, and business technology consulting, delivered through strategic partnerships with Dataiku, Denodo, and Neo4j, alongside our technology talent management practice.

**Role Summary**

Sciente is hiring a mid-level, India-based Pre-sales Techno-functional Consultant (FCC & GRC) who turns BFSI clients' financial crime compliance (FCC) and governance, risk and compliance (GRC) problems into solution concepts, and grows into a senior pre-sales role.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **Problem discovery.**
   Run discovery sessions with compliance, risk, operations and IT stakeholders at banks, insurers and other financial institutions. Turn vague pain points into structured problem statements with scope, root causes and success measures.
2. **Solution conceptualisation.**
   Design solution concepts across FCC (AML, sanctions screening, fraud, KYC/CDD, transaction monitoring) and GRC (regulatory mapping, controls, risk registers, audit readiness).
3. **Partner-stack architecture.**
   Map each problem to Sciente's capabilities and partner technologies, for example:

* Neo4j for entity resolution, network analytics and linking regulations to controls and risks
* Denodo for unifying data spread across core banking, case management and GRC systems
* Dataiku for models, analytics and explainable decisioning

1. **Proposals and effort estimates.**
   Write solution sections of RFP/RFI responses and proposals, including scope, assumptions, phasing and effort estimates, with delivery leads.
2. **Demos and proofs of concept.**
   Build and present demos and small proofs of concept tailored to the client's data and use case.
3. **Client presentations.**
   Present to both business buyers (Chief Compliance Officer, Chief Risk Officer, Head of Financial Crime) and technical buyers (CIO, CDO, enterprise architects), mostly remotely, with occasional travel.
4. **Market and regulatory awareness.**
   Track regulatory change and industry practice in the markets Sciente serves, and feed this into reusable solution accelerators.
5. **Handover to delivery.**
   Hand over won deals with clear solution documentation so delivery starts without rework.

**Requirements**

Candidates need depth in either GRC or FCC domain and working knowledge of the other.

**Must have**

* Roughly 6 to 10 years in BFSI, including hands-on work in FCC or GRC
* Deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working knowledge of the other domain, enough to frame its problems credibly:

**(a) FCC:**
AML transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, fraud detection, KYC/CDD or case management

**(b) GRC:**
regulatory compliance mapping, risk and control frameworks, operational risk, internal audit or policy management

* Hands-on experience with at least one FCC or GRC platform, as implementer, consultant or user
* Hands-on work experience in technology solutioning is a must
* Solid data literacy: data models, data quality, integration patterns, and how analytics and models drive alerts or risk scores
* Familiarity with regulatory expectations beyond one country, such as FATF standards and at least one of MAS, BNM, US BSA/FinCEN
* Strong written and spoken English; able to whiteboard a solution live with senior client stakeholders
* Willingness to take calls across APAC and US time zones, and to travel occasionally

Find out more: www.sciente.com

When you apply, you voluntarily consent to the disclosure, collection and use of your personal data for employment/recruitment and related purposes in accordance with the SCIENTE Group Privacy Policy, a copy of which is published at SCIENTE’s website (https://www.sciente.com/privacy-policy/).

Confidentiality is assured, and only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

88288953.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
88288953.description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
Atlassians have flexibility in where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, as part of being a distributed-first company.
  
  
Atlassian is seeking an exceptional Solutions Engineer who is passionate about addressing complex customer challenges and securing significant enterprise deals. In this role, you will collaborate closely with the enterprise sales team and regional channel partners to gain a deep understanding of our customers' needs. You will strategize on navigating various scenarios, deliver compelling demonstrations, and ultimately drive business closure. Your expertise will be crucial in ensuring that our solutions effectively meet the demands of our clients, contributing to their success and the growth of Atlassian.
  
  
**Your future team**
With over 300,000 customers worldwide, Atlassian is helping organisations like NASA, IBM, Hubspot, Samsung and Coca-Cola advance humanity through the power of incredible software that unleashes the potential of every team.
  
  
With a focus on value selling, we help our customers understand how our products combine to create enterprise solutions that transform their business’s outcomes. We’re different from other organisations because we approach everything we do using our value of ‘play as a team'. We support each other, celebrate our wins together and share knowledge. Our employees work with Atlassian, not for Atlassian.
  
  
Our team enjoys high earnings potential with the enterprise white space opportunity ahead of us, selling impactful products that are at the forefront of cloud and artificial intelligence utilization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Strategic Technical Engagement: Partner with sales to engage in customer discovery, identifying business challenges and desired outcomes while mapping them to Atlassian’s value propositions and solutions.
* Opportunity Identification: Identify opportunities for cross-product and solution expansion to maximize customer value.
* Technical Problem Solving: Investigate and understand client pain points to craft meaningful solutions.
* Product Expertise: Act as a product expert, clearly articulating and demonstrating how Atlassian’s software drives collaboration and productivity.
* Value-Driven Demonstrations: Deliver engaging demonstrations showcasing how Atlassian’s solutions empower teams and drive outcomes.
* Technical Sales Leadership: Guide customers on best practices and implementation strategies to achieve success with Atlassian software.
* Sales Collaboration: Build strong partnerships with sales counterparts to improve engagement and optimize the sales cycle.
* Customer Advocacy: Gather customer feedback and competitive insights, sharing them with product teams to influence improvements.

**Qualifications**
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
* 10+ years of experience in Presales, Solution Engineering, or working in customer facing roles for technology vendors or technology driven organizations.
* Deep knowledge of Atlassian’s product suite and ability to articulate its value in solving complex business challenges.
* Proven experience delivering impactful product/solution demonstrations and leading technical evaluations.
* Ability to identify solution expansion opportunities and align with customer goals.
* Highly organized, able to work in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment, balancing competing priorities and deadlines.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills to influence technical and business stakeholders, with the ability to present to and persuade varied audiences.
* Collaborative mindset with a passion for solving problems and empowering customers, along with a “roll-up-your-sleeves” approach focused on execution and continuous improvement.

**Benefits & Perks**
Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
**go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits**
**.**
**About Atlassian**
At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
  
  
We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
  
  
To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
**go.atlassian.com/crh**
**.**
In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

ceb419ea.title: Technical Presales Engineer
ceb419ea.description:
**Title: Senior Technical Presales Engineer**

**Location: Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bangalore**

**Work mode: remote (required travelling)**

**Experience: 3+ years Technical Presales experience in cybersecurity and AI security products**

**\*Only immediate joiners or maximum 15 days NP candidates preferred\***

**ABOUT KAPALINS:**

Kapalins builds an AI-native security and governance platform for enterprises adopting generative AI: managing AI risk, model and data exposure, governance and compliance across LLMs, copilots and agentic systems.

Enterprises in India are deploying GenAI far faster than they are governing it. Security and risk teams are being asked to sign off on systems they cannot see. That gap is our market, and it is opening now.

**THE ROLE:**

We're looking for a Pre-Sales Engineer who can translate the technical depth of our platform into a compelling, credible story for CISOs, CTOs, and security architects — and prove it live. You'll be the technical voice in the room alongside our sales team: running demos, answering the hard architecture and threat-model questions, and helping prospects see exactly how Kapālins secures their AI estate.

This is not a scripted-demo role. You need to genuinely understand LLM security, agentic AI risk, and enterprise compliance well enough to improvise under technical questioning from senior security buyers.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN:**

* Deliver technical product demonstrations of the Kapālins platform — AI Trust Index, Proxy/Probe/Connector observation modes, LLM Hardening, Policy Shield, and Compliance Shield — tailored to each prospect's AI estate and threat model
* Partner with Sales on discovery calls to understand a prospect's AI/LLM footprint (models, copilots, agents) and map it to relevant platform capabilities
* Respond to technical questions on prompt injection, jailbreak defense, model integrity, data leakage, and agentic AI runtime risk in real time, with credibility
* Own technical responses for RFPs/RFIs, security questionnaires, and architecture reviews
* Map customer compliance requirements (APRA CPS 234/230, DPDP Act, ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS) to platform features and evidence output
* Run and support proof-of-concept (PoC) deployments, including connecting a prospect's AI providers and interpreting resulting risk scores
* Act as the technical bridge between prospects, Sales, and Product — feeding real buyer objections and gaps back into the roadmap
* Build and maintain demo environments, sandbox scenarios (e.g., simulated attack/injection scenarios), and reusable technical collateral

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

* 3+ years of relevant experience in cybersecurity and/or AI/LLM security — pre-sales, sales engineering, security engineering, or a security-adjacent technical role
* Working understanding of LLM/AI-specific threat vectors: prompt injection, jailbreaking, model poisoning, adversarial ML, data leakage, agentic AI risk
* Familiarity with security frameworks relevant to AI: OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF — and ideally exposure to regulatory frameworks like DPDP, APRA CPS 234/230, or ISO 42001
* Demonstrated ability to explain complex technical concepts to a non-technical or executive audience, and to hold your own with a highly technical one (CISO/security architect level)
* Comfort running live product demonstrations and improvising through unscripted technical questions

**STRONGLY PREFERRED:**

* Prior pre-sales/sales engineering experience at a cybersecurity or AI security product company
* Hands-on familiarity with LLM APIs and platforms (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI) or enterprise copilots (Microsoft 365 Copilot, GitHub Copilot)
* Experience with API integrations, gateways/proxies, or SIEM/XDR ecosystems
* Prior experience supporting RFPs, security questionnaires, or compliance evidence packages
* Startup or fast-scaling product-company experience, comfortable with ambiguity and a fast-evolving product

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:**

* Prospects leave every demo with a clear, credible understanding of how Kapālins governs their specific AI estate.
* Technical objections in the sales cycle get resolved fast and accurately, shortening deal cycles.
* PoCs convert at a high rate because the technical story lands cleanly with security buyers.

**HOW TO APPLY:**

Apply through LinkedIn OR you can also write to
**swati.maheshwari@kapalins.com**
with the subject line: Senior Technical Sales Engineer | [Your Name]

Know more: www.kapalins.com

Kapalins is an equal opportunity employer.

Best Regards,

Kapalins

ff973b3c.title: Presales Manager - Wholesale Banking
ff973b3c.description:
**Position**

**Pre-Sales Manager**

**Experience**

**5-12 Years**

**Grade**

**T3XX - Senior Manager / AVP**

**Location**

**Mumbai/ Chennai**

**About FuEL**

**FuEL**
is
**Intellect's Flagship program**
designed to develop the next generation of transformation leaders for the global Fintech/Insuretech industry.

Created for high-potential professionals, the program equips participants to move beyond operational excellence and become trusted advisors who help financial institutions reimagine business models, accelerate digital & AI transformation and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

Your journey begins with an immersive four-week learning experience covering Digital Transformation, Product Immersion, Design Thinking and AI-led Banking Innovation. You'll gain deep exposure to Intellect's award-winning banking platforms across Consumer Banking, Corporate Banking, Transaction Banking, Capital Markets, Wealth and Insurance, while working alongside some of the industry's foremost banking, product and technology experts.

Explore more at: www.intellectdesign.com

**The Opportunity**

The best presales leaders don't just respond to RFPs—they shape how clients think about their business challenges before a competitive process even begins. This role is for that kind of leader.

As
**Presales Manager**
, you will own the solutioning agenda across complex, high-value deal pursuits—bringing together deep banking domain expertise, strategic thinking, consultative selling, and genuine individual and integrated product mastery to drive measurable customer value and win business that matters. You will be leading efforts to drive new sales, cross sell, and upsell at Intellect’s Key relationships engaging at the CXO level and solution with authority, and build the presales capability that turns market opportunities into signed engagements.

You will engage with business leaders across Retail Banking, Wholesale Banking, Transaction Banking, Payments, Lending, Treasury, and Wealth Management to understand strategic objectives, diagnose business challenges, and translate them into differentiated transformation opportunities.

The role requires the ability to ask the right questions, challenge conventional thinking, bring external market perspectives, and guide customers from problem identification to solution vision.

You should be comfortable in working in a networked org design and in taking ownership of the outcome therefore to pool the best resources and solution that OneIntellect has to offer to its customers. This is a role for someone who is as comfortable in a boardroom solutioning session as they are shaping product strategy conversations with internal roadmap teams.

**Role Definition**

The Pre-Sales Manager primarily drives the early-stage sales cycle by actively shaping and qualifying pipeline opportunities through discovery and validation. They are responsible for translating customer requirements into compelling value propositions and demonstrating product value, while providing critical support in later pipeline stages to convert opportunities into successful deals.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Prospect Understanding**

Engage with banking executives, business heads, product owners, and operations leaders to understand strategic priorities. Analyse banking business models, revenue drivers, operational challenges, and competitive pressures. Translate market trends into actionable transformation opportunities. Actively validate critical deal qualifiers—including Need/Problem, Decision Makers, Customer’s Timeline, Customer’s Budget runway, and Proposal intent to successfully graduate opportunities.

**2. Consultative Value Selling**

Create Business Value to shape opportunities, influence decisions and improve win probability. Ability to articulate measurable business outcomes, ROI, and value propositions aligned to customer objectives. Help banks rethink customer journeys, operating models, and product strategies.

**3. Product Demonstrations and Client Workshops**

Conduct high-quality product demonstrations, discovery workshops, proof-of-concept sessions, technical presentations, and solution walkthroughs for prospective clients aligned to their business needs. Ensure demo is aligned to use cases to prospect’s requirements and perform Demo Diagnostic

**4. RFP/RFI and Bid Support**

Lead responses to RFPs, RFIs, questionnaires, and proposal documents. Ensure that responses are accurate, complete, compelling, and aligned with the customer’s stated requirements.

**5. Solutioning and Proposal Development**

Design tailored high quality solution propositions using the company’s product capabilities, platform strengths, implementation approach, and domain expertise. Support the creation of scope documents, solution architecture inputs, effort estimates, implementation plans, timelines, assumptions, exclusions, and commercial inputs. Ensure that the proposed solution is practical, differentiated, and aligned to the customer’s needs.

**6. Coordination with Product, Engineering and Delivery Teams**

Work closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Delivery, Implementation, and Support teams to validate solution feasibility, effort assumptions, customisation needs, integration approach, dependencies, and delivery risks.

**7. Sales Enablement**

Equip the Sales team with product collateral, demo scripts, solution notes, competitive insights, objection-handling points, customer-specific messaging, and proof points to support effective selling.

**8. Market and Customer Feedback Loop**

Capture feedback from prospects, clients, partners, competitive situations, demonstrations, and RFPs, and share structured insights with Product teams for roadmap, positioning, and solution improvement.

**9. Deal Conversion Support**

Actively drive the early-stage sales cycle by shaping and graduating qualified opportunities. Act as a bridge between Sales, Product, and Delivery to ensure that the proposed solution is credible, client-specific, implementable, and capable of supporting successful deal closure.

**10. Knowledge Management**

Maintain updated value proposition product decks, reusable proposal content, case studies, standard responses, FAQs, and solution artefacts to improve pre-sales productivity and consistency.

**11. Transition to Delivery**

Support the handover from Sales to Delivery after deal closure by ensuring that the agreed scope, solution commitments, assumptions, risks, and client expectations are clearly documented and communicated.

**Experience & Qualifications**

● Extensive experience in the BFSI industry, with a strong track record in Presales, Solution Consulting, Product Consulting, or other customer-facing roles within banking, financial services, or fintech organizations.

● Deep domain expertise in one or more banking business areas, with the ability to understand customer needs, analyse business challenges, and design differentiated, practical, and commercially viable solution propositions.

● Proven experience leading complex sales pursuits, including customer discovery, executive workshops, product demonstrations and proof-of-concept engagements.

● Demonstrated ability to articulate product value, competitive differentiation, implementation strategy, and business outcomes, translating product capabilities into compelling customer-specific solutions.

● Strong commercial acumen with experience preparing solution proposals, scope documents, effort estimates, implementation plans, commercial inputs, and customer-facing collateral to support strategic business opportunities.

● Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence CXOs, business leaders, technical teams, partners, and cross-functional stakeholders across the sales lifecycle.

● Demonstrated ability to capture customer feedback, competitive intelligence, market trends, and emerging industry insights, leveraging them to strengthen product positioning, solution offerings, and continuous improvement.

● Proven success in enabling high-performing sales organizations through reusable solution assets, demo environments, knowledge repositories, and best practices, while ensuring a seamless transition from Sales to Delivery and consistently driving successful customer outcomes.

**Why This Role**

You will be operating at the forefront of banking transformation—where market strategy meets client needs, and where the quality of solutioning directly influences business success. You will have the opportunity, authority, and mandate to build a high-performing presales function that not only nurtures opportunities but also helps create them. If you're looking for a senior leadership role where your expertise, customer relationships, and strategic judgment can shape outcomes and drive meaningful business impact, this is the opportunity.

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We are looking for world-class Solution Architects to join our Global field teams whose technical skills and customer savvy will help customers understand and utilize the value of the cutting-edge data platform that we are building. They must share our passion about reinventing the data platform and thrive in a dynamic environment.
  
  
The Solution Architect will work hand-in-hand with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Marketing. In this role you will work directly with the account sales team on a handful of global accounts with GCCs in India to accelerate their Snowflake journey. The Solution Architect will be responsible for providing the technical expertise to make Snowflake customers successful in driving existing projects and uncover new use cases. This data architect will have a broad range of skills and experience ranging from data architecture to ETL/ELT, data science, security, performance analysis, analytics, etc. He/she will have the insight to make the connection between a customer’s specific business problems and Snowflake’s solution, the customer-facing skills to communicate that connection and vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences, and the technical skills to be able to not only build demos and execute proof-of-concepts but also to provide consultative assistance on architecture and implementation.
  
  
***This is a hands-on, individual contributor role with high visibility across the organisation.***
The Solution Architect has the willingness to jump in and do what it takes to make Snowflake and our customers successful. It means keeping up to date on the ever-evolving technologies for data and analytics in order to be an authoritative resource for both Snowflake and customers. They should work collaboratively with a broad range of people, both inside and outside the company.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers
* Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation
* Maintain a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing
* Be an advocate and develop mutual trust with the technical audience on the customer side
* Run training sessions, workshops, webinars to help customers become proficient in Snowflake
* Keeping customers up to date on key Snowflake product updates and future roadmaps to help them represent Snowflake to their clients about latest technology solutions and benefits
* Run technical enablement programs to provide best practices, and solution design workshops to help customers create effective solutions
* Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive Snowflake adoption
* Represent Snowflake at customer or industry events
* Forward Strategic thinking - quickly grasp the essence of new concepts and business value messaging. Sharing customer success stories & case studies to showcase the impact of Snowflake

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Minimum 10+ years of experience working in customer facing solution engineering (tech sales) role, preferably with large Global accounts
* University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience
* Strong competency on modern data stacks, ETL/ELT, data warehouse/lake, data science and data apps
* Outstanding skills presenting to both technical and executive audiences, in small groups or at public events, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.
* Hands-on expertise with SQL and Python
* Experience working with large global accounts, GSIs and/or Global Capability Centers
* Industry experience in either BFSI, Manufacturing, Technology or HCLS domains
* Experience with large-scale database technology (e.g. Netezza, Exadata, Teradata, Greenplum, Hadoop etc.)
* Presales experience in data related tech products
* Sound understanding and experience in the enterprise market and technology ecosystem

**ADDED BONUS FOR:**

* Data Science/AI/ML experience across a variety of platforms
* Familiarity and experience with common BI and data exploration tools (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI, Metabase etc).
* Prior Snowflake experience is a plus
* Cloud Provider Experience - Amazon AWS/Microsoft Azure/Google Cloud
* Data modeling and data architecture experience
* Experience selling enterprise SaaS software to Global Accounts

**Do you enjoy figuring out how equipment works—and feel proud when everything comes together at a customer’s site?**

**A camera captures the picture. But it takes someone who understands the complete workflow to make the experience work.**

**At FSSL, we’re looking for that person: someone who is curious, enjoys practical work, asks good questions, and stays involved until the solution works reliably.**

**Company:**
Focus Spectrum Solutions LLP (FSSL)

**Location:**
Bengaluru | Travel across South India required

**Experience:**
Preferably 2–5 years in AV integration, technical pre-sales, installation, or application support.

**About FSSL**

**Focus Spectrum Solutions LLP is a Canon Visual Network Solutions Authorized Partner**
, serving customers and AV system integrators across South India.

We provide PTZ camera and integrated AV solutions for corporate meeting rooms, auditoriums, educational institutions, studios, houses of worship, and hybrid event environments.

Our work goes beyond selecting equipment. We help customers understand what is possible, design a practical workflow, and bring it to life through demonstrations, installation support, configuration, and training.

**Your Role**

**You will help turn a customer’s idea into a working AV solution—from understanding their requirements and planning the system to testing it on-site and helping their team use it confidently.**

**The satisfaction comes from moments like these: a customer confidently operating the system you configured, a camera capturing exactly the right view, or a technical problem solved because you took the time to understand it.**

**What You’ll Do**

* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable PTZ camera and AV solutions.
* Conduct site surveys and plan camera placement, cabling, connectivity, and installation needs.
* Design workflows connecting cameras, controllers, switchers, audio systems, computers, displays, and streaming platforms.
* Prepare bills of materials, technical proposals, connection diagrams, and compliance statements.
* Conduct product demonstrations and proof-of-concept setups for customers and AV integrators.
* Support installation, mounting coordination, cabling, IP configuration, camera presets, and controller setup.
* Configure and test SDI, HDMI, USB, and IP video workflows.
* Integrate camera systems with vMix, OBS, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and similar platforms.
* Troubleshoot video, audio, networking, and camera-control issues.
* Work closely with sales teams, OEM technical teams, and installation partners.
* Train customers and prepare clear system documentation for handover.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Working knowledge of cameras, AV equipment, and audio-video signal flow.
* Familiarity with IP addressing, network switches, PoE, and network troubleshooting.
* Exposure to PTZ cameras, NDI, SRT, RTSP, SDI, or HDMI.
* The ability to listen carefully and explain technical concepts in simple language.
* A hands-on approach to installation, testing, and troubleshooting.
* Ownership, patience, and respect for the customer’s time and expectations.
* Curiosity to keep learning as technology evolves.

**You don’t need to know every product on day one. You should be willing to learn, ask when unsure, and follow through on what you take responsibility for.**

**Qualifications**

**Travel Is Part of the Role**

**FSSL serves clients across South India**
. You must be willing to travel for site surveys, demonstrations, installations, commissioning, customer training, and technical support.

If you enjoy meeting people, understanding different environments, and seeing your work take shape on-site, this could be a good fit.

**Why This Role Could Be Right for You**

**This is an opportunity to build your understanding of the complete AV workflow, work with Canon PTZ solutions, and develop the technical and customer-facing skills to take a project from requirement to handover.**

**We value the person who asks, “What does the customer need to achieve, and how can we make it work well?”**

As a Solution Architect, you’ll be collaborating with Wealth Enterprise Architecture, API, Core Platforms, Security and Natwest Group CRM Centre of Excellence enterprise, along with the Wealth CRM platforms team to architect and deliver solutions leveraging Microsoft D365 as the new CRM in Wealth, integrated with existing Wealth technology stack.

You’ll be supporting the growth of architecting capability, of the solution and its interfaces, validate technology assumptions, evaluate implementation alternatives, and support the functional consultants and CRM engineers with lower level solution design to ensure that develop the a pipeline of features and improvements to allow frequent and incremental delivery of end-user value whilst leveraging Microsoft latest innovations and contributing to the development of architecture skills across the team by sharing knowledge, best practices, lessons learned, and mentoring others.

As well as this, you’ll be:

* Leading on the development of High-Level Solution Designs (HLSD), interacting with WCDIO Enterprise Architects, Security, Infrastructure, API and Data colleagues
* Owning the technical design issues and driving resolution through the iteration of the technical solution design
* Leading the activities to shape requirements, validating designs and prototypes to deliver change that aligns with the target architecture
* Promoting adaptive design practices to drive collaboration of feature teams around a common technical vision using continuous feedback
* Making recommendations of potential impacts to existing and prospective end-users of the latest technology and clients’ trends

**The skills you'll need**

To take on this role, you’ll need practitioner knowledge of solution architecture frameworks, modern technologies such as Cloud, microservices and AI, agile architecture and DevOps practices, including a deep understanding of business use cases and emerging trends that drive organisational success.

You’ll bring practitioner experience of defining and developing strategic solution architectures that align with organisational objectives. This will include experience of engaging with partners across the organisation to define architectures that deliver tangible business outcomes.

You’ll also demonstrate experience of:

* Collaborative decision-making processes, partnering with business and technology colleagues to articulate and evolve architectural direction
* Creating business cases to influence senior stakeholders to secure investment for architecture initiatives
* Participating in overseeing and assuring the quality of architecture designs, with a focus on risk management and governance
* Supporting architecture and design reviews to validate that solutions meet business needs and comply with architecture standards
* People capability development, including mentoring, supporting professional development, encouraging knowledge sharing across architecture teams and promoting best practices

We are looking for an experienced Core Salesforce Solution Architect to lead end-to-end architecture and technical solution design for enterprise Salesforce implementations and transformation programs. **Job Title**

Solution Architect

**Job Description Summary**

The Solution Architect – Microsoft Collaboration & Power Platform is responsible for the architecture, governance, automation, operational excellence, and strategic direction of the organization's Microsoft 365 collaboration ecosystem. This role serves as the technical lead for SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, Power Platform, and related Microsoft 365 collaboration services.  
  
The architect partners with business leaders, security teams, infrastructure teams, and external vendors to design scalable, secure, and cost-effective collaboration solutions while ensuring regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, and exceptional end-user experiences.  
  
The role requires deep technical expertise combined with strong business acumen, leadership, governance, and communication skills.

**Job Description**

**Key Responsibilities**

*Microsoft 365 Collaboration Architecture*

* Lead architecture and governance for:
  + SharePoint Online
  + Microsoft Teams
  + OneDrive for Business
  + Viva Connections and related collaboration technologies
* Develop and maintain collaboration platform roadmaps.
* Define standards, best practices, and architectural patterns.
* Evaluate new Microsoft features and determine organizational adoption strategies.
* Serve as escalation point for complex platform issues and strategic initiatives.

*SharePoint & OneDrive Governance*

* Define and implement SharePoint governance frameworks.
* Establish site lifecycle management processes.
* Develop strategies to manage storage growth and platform sprawl.
* Implement controls for sharing, permissions, and external collaboration.
* Manage archival and lifecycle processes for inactive and terminated employee data.
* Develop solutions to optimize storage costs while maintaining compliance requirements.

*Microsoft Teams Governance*

* Design and maintain Teams governance policies.
* Define standards for team creation, lifecycle, ownership, and guest access.
* Partner with Security and Risk teams to ensure compliance with corporate policies.
* Develop operational dashboards and reporting for Teams adoption and utilization.

*Power Platform Governance*

* Establish governance strategy for:
  + Power Apps
  + Power Automate
* Define Dev, Test, and Production Environment Standards.
* Implement Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies.
* Govern custom connectors, gateways, and application ownership.
* Review and approve platform architecture for business-critical solutions.
* Management of storage consumption

*Automation & Innovation*

* Identify opportunities to automate manual operational processes.
* Design solutions using:
  + Power Automate
  + Azure Functions
  + Logic Apps
  + Custom APIs and integrations
* Partner with engineering and operations teams to improve service delivery and operational efficiency.
* Develop reusable operational frameworks and automation patterns.

*Reporting & Analytics*

* Develop executive dashboards and operational reporting.
* Monitor collaboration platform health, adoption, utilization, and governance metrics.
* Use data and analytics to drive informed decision-making.
* Provide leadership reporting on platform usage, compliance, storage consumption, and operational effectiveness.

*Vendor & Stakeholder Management*

* Partner with internal business leaders and technology teams.
* Collaborate with external vendors and managed service providers.
* Drive accountability for service delivery and operational improvements.
* Participate in strategic planning and budgeting discussions.

*Security & Compliance*

* Ensure collaboration platforms comply with:
  + Corporate security standards
  + Data governance requirements
  + Regulatory requirements
  + Records management policies
* Partner with Identity, Security, and Risk teams to implement security controls.
* Support audits and compliance reviews.

Experience

* 5+ years administering and architecting Microsoft 365 collaboration solutions.
* Experience supporting large enterprise environments (10,000+ users preferred).

* OneDrive for Business

* Power Automate

* Microsoft Purview
* Azure

* Stakeholder engagement
* Problem solving

Implement identity and authentication frameworks including SSO, SAML, and OAuth.

2be0209a.title: Senior Solution Architect
2be0209a.description:
**Pls note : This position is for work from office only.**

  

**We are Looking for only Male candidates who are immediate joiner or candidates who are serving notice period.**

  

**Communication skills for this position should be good.**

  
  

**Tru Inc is seeking Senior Solution Architect.**

  

You will own the technical design of client platforms across the cloud, data, application, and AI layers. You report to the CTO and set the architectural direction that delivery teams build against. Your designs decide how reliable, secure, scalable, and cost-efficient our client solutions are in production.

  

**JOB LOCATION AND ADDRESS**

  
  

Plot No E 275, Industrial Area, Sector 75, Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar, Punjab 160071

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

  

* Lead solution design with stakeholders. Translate business goals into scalable, documented architectures that delivery teams can build from without ambiguity.
* Design cloud-native solutions across **Azure and GCP.** Balance performance, cost, scalability, and security from the first diagram.
* Architect data layers across SQL and NoSQL stores (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch) and vector databases for AI retrieval workloads.
* Design AI and agentic capabilities into client products. Cover LLM API integration, retrieval-augmented generation, and agent workflows, each with clear guardrails and evaluation criteria.
* Set engineering standards and provide technical leadership. Review delivery teams' work against architecture, code quality, and security expectations, and mentor engineers toward those standards.
* Architect integrations across applications, APIs, and third-party services so data flows reliably between systems.
* Identify performance and cost bottlenecks in live systems and direct the optimizations that fix them.
* Produce and maintain architecture documentation, diagrams, and decision records that hold up after your direct involvement ends.

  

**REQUIREMENTS**

  

**Technical Skills**

  

* 8 or more years in software engineering, including at least 3 years designing solutions as an architect or technical lead.
* Production experience designing cloud-native systems on **Azure and GCP,** across compute, networking, storage, and identity.
* Hands-on development background across Node.js, React, Redux, and PHP, with the depth to set patterns and review code rather than only review diagrams.
* Data architecture experience across relational databases (PostgreSQL or MySQL) and NoSQL stores (MongoDB, Elasticsearch), including schema design, indexing, and query optimization.
* Experience designing LLM-based features for production, including model API integration (such as Anthropic Claude or OpenAI), retrieval-augmented generation, and vector databases.
* Practical prompt and agent design skill. You can write effective prompts, structure agentic workflows, and define how to evaluate and constrain model outputs for reliability.
* Strong grasp of software architecture principles, design patterns, and API design (REST and GraphQL).
* Solid security practice, including IAM, OWASP, and data protection, applied from the design stage.

  

**Preferred Experience**

  

* Containerization and orchestration with Docker and Kubernetes, plus infrastructure as code with Terraform.
* DevOps and CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions or similar) and observability tooling such as OpenTelemetry, Datadog, or Grafana.
* AWS or Azure architect certification.
* Event-driven and microservices architecture at scale, and exposure to the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for tool-connected AI systems.

  

**Soft Skills**

  

* Ability to troubleshoot complex systems under pressure and explain your diagnosis clearly.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with sound judgment on trade-offs.
* Effective communication and collaboration across product, delivery, and client teams.
* Ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and defend an architecture on its merits.

* Salesforce DX and modular package architecture (unlocked/shared packages).
* Exposure to AppExchange apps: Conga, DocuSign, JIRA, Slack, Experience Cloud.

**Requirements**

  

* 8 + years of Salesforce experience with at least 3 years in architecture roles.
* Salesforce certifications: Application Architect, FSL Consultant, Loyalty Management (preferred), Integration Architect.
* Strong verbal and written communication to lead client workshops and demos.
* Prior experience working in agile/scrum delivery models and managing dev teams.

  

**What We Offer:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development.
* A collaborative and innovative work environment.

In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
  
  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Gurgaon, Haryana, India; Pune, Maharashtra, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience in software engineering, enterprise cloud architecture, or technical consulting
* 3 years of experience in advanced AI/ML architecture, deploying generative AI applications, intelligent agents, or LLM-powered solutions globally.
* Experience in Python including implementation and deployment of tiered microservices applications.
* Experience deploying production-grade cloud infrastructure or architecting and building cloud-based data solutions (e.g., enterprise data warehouses, data lakes, data pipelines, and associated technologies).

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field.
* Experience pioneering multimodal AI solutions (text, image, video, and voice) to solve novel, previously unsolved enterprise workflow challenges.
* Experience with AI security, Large Language Model (LLM) governance, enterprise guardrails, and global compliance requirements (e.g., data privacy regulations, data sovereignty).
* Ability to architect highly resilient, globally distributed Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and securely connecting LLMs with disparate legacy enterprise databases.
* Recognized industry thought leadership (e.g., patents, published research, keynotes) in Generative AI, agentic workflows, or large-scale cloud data infrastructure.

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
As a Cloud AI Engineer, you will play a key leadership role in ensuring that strategic customers have the best experience adopting Gemini Enterprise alongside the broader Google Cloud Agentic AI suite of products. You will design and implement robust, production-ready application architectures to support customer use cases, leveraging Gemini Enterprise and core Google AI products. You will work with customers to identify opportunities to transform their workflows with autonomous agents, actively removing technical barriers to ensure successful deployment and high adoption rates of Gemini Enterprise. You will have access to Google’s technology to monitor application performance, debug and troubleshoot complex agent behaviors, and address customer and partner needs. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end and timely execution of adopting Google Cloud Platform solutions to the customer.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead and oversee the global delivery and implementation of Gemini Enterprise solutions, utilizing Agent Development Kits (ADKs) to solve highly complex, enterprise-scale technical challenges.
* Serve as the trusted technical advisor to C-suite executives at Google’s most strategic global accounts, shaping their overarching AI strategy and accelerating the adoption of Gemini Enterprise.
* Influence the core product roadmap by translating complex architectural challenges into actionable requirements for Google's engineering teams.
* Deliver leading practice recommendations and high-stakes technical presentations to executive boards and key business stakeholders to secure massive-scale technical wins.
* Act as a thought leader and mentor across the Google Cloud organization, elevating the technical acumen of engineers and shaping best practices for agentic AI architectures.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

c97d6382.title: Consultant - Cloud Operations
c97d6382.description:
Join us at Orange Business!
  
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
  
**About The Role**
Be at the forefront of cloud innovation by collaborating with international customers to deliver tailored solutions and enhance operational excellence in a virtual, multi-stakeholder environment.
  
  

* Engage proactively with international customers to understand and address their cloud operational requirements through customized solutions.
* Collaborate seamlessly with internal teams to support the integration and delivery of cloud services, ensuring consistent service quality.
* Identify and resolve technical issues efficiently, applying methodical problem-solving techniques to maintain service continuity.
* Operate effectively within a virtual environment, coordinating with stakeholders across various time zones to support cloud operations.
* Manage unexpected challenges calmly and strategically to ensure prompt resolution and minimal operational impact.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing operational processes and overall service performance.

**About You**
You are a knowledgeable professional with over 7 years of experience in cloud operations and virtualization technologies, holding a graduate degree in science, engineering (BE/B Tech), or M.Sc. IT. Your strong technical skills include advanced knowledge of vCloud Director, VMware ESXi and vSphere, NSX-T, along with hands-on experience with key infrastructure such as Dell and Cisco chassis, complemented by a solid understanding of public cloud environments including Azure. You combine expertise in Linux and automation tools with clear communication and effective customer engagement skills, consistently adapting solutions to meet evolving needs.
  
  
**Your professional skills:**

* Demonstrate advanced management and configuration skills in vCloud Director environments to optimize cloud operations.
* Apply in-depth technical expertise in VMware ESXi and vSphere, including proficiency in vCenter and ESXi management tasks.
* Utilize comprehensive knowledge of NSX-T to implement and manage advanced network virtualization features.
* Experience with hardware including Dell M1000 Chassis and M630, Cisco UCS, and HPE chassis to support infrastructure needs.
* Apply understanding of public cloud platforms, particularly Microsoft Azure, to design and maintain effective cloud solutions.
* Exhibit proficiency in Linux operating systems and automation tools to streamline cloud service management.
* Communicate clearly and effectively with customers and team members to foster understanding and collaboration.
* Provide proactive customer support that ensures positive experiences and addresses client concerns efficiently.
* Adapt problem-solving approaches as required by changing environments to maintain stable cloud operations.
* Collaborate with colleagues to advance team objectives and share knowledge for mutual benefit.

**Your soft skills:**

* Contributes to team success through cooperation and knowledge sharing across functions.
* Communicates ideas and technical information clearly to diverse audiences.
* Responds flexibly to changing priorities and operational requirements.
* Maintains a professional and approachable demeanor when interacting with stakeholders.
* Demonstrates persistence in resolving challenges while maintaining composure.

Join Orange as a Consultant in cloud operations and engage in shaping the future of cloud technologies on an international scale. Here, you will apply your expertise to provide practical, client-focused solutions while working within a collaborative and dynamic team setting. The role offers the opportunity to continuously expand technical knowledge and contribute to operational excellence, supporting a culture of learning and innovation aligned with Orange’s values of integrity and respect.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

**Only Your Skills Matter**
Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neuroatypia, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

cdefff34.title: Senior MDM Service Delivery Manager
cdefff34.description:
**Life Unlimited.** At Smith & Nephew (S+N) is a large multinational Medical Technology organization with an extensive Enterprise Applications ecosystem to run end-to-end business operations. Master Data Management (MDM) is at the core of this ecosystem to create, govern and maintain trusted master records, and to establish a single source of truth across the enterprise. At S+N, Syndigo and Alation are our primary MDM and data governance platforms, amongst others. These MDM systems are tightly integrated with ERPs, other best-in-class enterprise systems such as PLM (Windchill), Data Warehouse (Snowflake), CRM (Salesforce), HR (Workday), and also external regulatory and marketplace platforms like GDSN.

**What will you be doing?**  
We are seeking a Senior Service Delivery Manager (SDM) for MDM who is responsible for end-to-end service delivery, operations and continuous improvement of Master Data Management (MDM).

The SDM owns the service lifecycle from Inception to Build through Run. This role ensures platform stability, data integrity and data quality while driving governance, vendor management, and roadmap execution.

The role serves as the primary interface between business stakeholders, data governance, IT, and external partners to ensure the MDM platform supports business growth, digital transformation, and data-driven decision-making.

This role is also expected to prepare for our strategic ERP transition to SAP S/4HANA.

**What will you need to be successful?**  
Service Delivery & Operational Excellence (30%), Platform Ownership, Strategy & Roadmap (20%), Program Delivery & Transformation Leadership (20%), Vendor, Partner & Commercial Management (15%), Continuous Improvement (15%).
  
  
**Education:** Bachelor's degree in information systems, Computer Science, Data Management, or related field. Master's degree preferred.
  
Experience: 10+ years in data platforms, MDM, or enterprise applications. 5+ years in a service delivery, platform owner, or product owner role.

  

**You Unlimited.**

We believe in crafting the greatest good for society. Our strongest investments are in our people and the patients we serve.

**Inclusion + Belonging:** Committed to Welcoming, Celebrating and Thriving., Learn more about Employee Inclusion Groups on our website ( https://www.smith-nephew.com/ ).

**Other reasons why you will love it here!**

* **Your Future:** Major medical coverage + policy exclusions and insurance non-medical limit. Educational Assistance.
* **Work/Life Balance** : Flexible Personal/Vacation Time Off, Privilege Leave, Floater Leave.
* **Flexibility** : Hybrid Work Model (For most professional roles)

* **Training:** Hands-On, Team-Customized, Mentorship.

Stay connected by joining our Talent Community .

We're more than just a company - we're a community! Follow us on LinkedIn to see how we support and empower our employees and patients every day.

Check us out on Glassdoor for a glimpse behind the scenes and a sneak peek into **You. Unlimited.** , life, culture, and benefits at S+N.

f1ef795c.title: Program Manager
f1ef795c.description:
**Project Manager JD**

**About FinacPlus**

FinacPlus is a Great Place to Work® Certified organization — a recognition of our people first culture, collaborative environment, and focus on professional growth. We provide high-end virtual business process and technology services to leading global clients across finance, banking, mortgage, research, and data services. At FinacPlus, you’ll work with world-class talent, cutting-edge technology, and international stakeholders — while still enjoying the openness, agility, and career visibility of a fast-growing company.

**About Our Client — Toorak Capital Partners**

You will be part of a dedicated engineering team supporting Toorak Capital Partners, a leading U.S.-based integrated correspondent lending platform that funds residential, multifamily, and mixed-use real estate loans across the U.S. and U.K. Headquartered in Summit, New Jersey, Toorak’s leadership team brings deep expertise across real estate lending, capital markets, securitization, asset management, and credit. To date, Toorak-funded projects have renovated or stabilized housing for 9,000+ families — averaging 500+ families every month.This is a rare opportunity to build mission-critical, cloud-based mortgage technology platforms that directly support one of the most respected players in the global mortgage finance industry.

**Forget Everything You Know About Project Management**

This isn't a role for someone who lives in status meetings and colour-coded Gantt charts. We need a delivery leader who thinks in systems, moves in sprints, and makes hard calls — fast.

**The Mission**

Own the end-to-end delivery of complex, high-stakes tech initiatives — across web applications, APIs, and operational platforms — from the first line of discovery to the final push to production. You're not a coordinator. You're the force that keeps engineering, product, and QA moving as one.

**What You'll Drive**

* Architect and own the delivery rhythm — sprint planning, release cadences, and retrospective loops — with precision and intent.
* Lead cross-functional squads through full-SDLC cycles: design, build, test, deploy, ship, repeat.
* Operate as the risk radar — surface dependencies, call out blockers, and execute mitigation before the team feels the friction.
* Translate technical complexity into sharp, audience-ready narratives — from engineering standups to C-suite briefings.
* Own the metrics. Analyse velocity trends, delivery gaps, and sprint health to continuously push performance forward.
* Govern the backlog ruthlessly — every undelivered feature has a home, a plan, and an owner.
* Partner with PMO and senior leadership to drive trade-off decisions with clarity and speed.

**What You Bring**

* **6–10 years**
  owning tech delivery in fast-moving, high-growth environments — startup DNA preferred.
* Deep command of Agile: Scrum, Kanban, sprint execution, and release governance — not just the theory.
* A track record of leading delivery of web applications, APIs, and operational tools from kick-off to production — steering teams, not writing code.
* The instinct to lead without authority — aligning engineers, designers, and product owners around a shared outcome.
* Surgical communication: you make complex delivery information crisp, clear, and impossible to ignore.
* Pioneer AI-driven process innovation across teams and platforms — reimagining how delivery works, not just automating how it's reported.
* Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and the Microsoft Office suite.
* Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or Information Systems — or the scars to prove equivalent experience.

**Bonus Points**

* CSM or equivalent Scrum Master/Project Manager certification.
* Experience in fintech, mortgage tech, or regulated financial services.

**Why This Role Will Challenge You**

You won't be managing projects. You'll be managing outcomes — in an environment where priorities shift, timelines compress, and the bar keeps rising. If you've been the calmest person in the room when everything is on fire, and the sharpest thinker when the roadmap needs rebuilding from scratch — this is your seat.

**Why Join FinacPlus?**

✔ Great Place to Work® Certified — collaborative, inclusive culture

✔ Exposure to global financial technology platforms

✔ Work with senior stakeholders across India, U.S. & U.K.

✔ Hybrid working with flexibility & work-life balance

✔ Competitive compensation and growth opportunities

✔ Opportunity to shape enterprise-grade products that create real-world impact

**We're not looking for someone who fits the mould. We're looking for someone who breaks it.**

**Only Immediate Joiners can apply. Candidates who are currently serving their notice period with 15 days or less remaining are also eligible to apply.**

**Location:**
Bangalore | Manyata Tech Park

**Timings:**
11:00 AM – 8:00 PM IST

**Compensation:**
Best in Industry

Nachweislich eFähigkeit, Programme/Projekte zu leiten. Fähigkeit, Programme zu dokumentieren, zu planen, zu vermarkten und auszuführen. Dokumentierte Projektmanagementfähigkeiten.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.

f9a2a3e3.description:
**Job Title: Customer Engagement Manager – AI Data Centers**

**Location: Mumbai / Hybrid.**

**Department: Commercial & Client Solutions / Enterprise Delivery**

**Reports To: AI Datacenter Head / SVP / Director of Customer Engagement & Commercial Delivery**

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a technically adept, client-facing Customer Engagement Manager to serve as the primary strategic interface between our internal design, construction, and operations teams and our hyperscale / enterprise AI clients.

You will lead the end-to-end customer journey—from technical deal structuring and site design customization through core & shell build tracking, liquid cooling layout sign-offs, and final data hall handover. This role requires an individual who can bridge the gap between high-level commercial relationship management and deep technical requirements for 100 kW to 150 kW+ per rack GPU deployments.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Technical Client Onboarding & Design Alignment

Requirement Translation: Act as the direct liaison between customer engineering teams and internal Design/MEP leads to translate high-density AI hardware roadmaps (NVIDIA H100/B200/GB200 clusters) into facility design specifications.

Liquid Cooling & Density Sign-Offs: Guide clients through core & shell layouts, secondary fluid loop handoffs, CDU placement preferences, and in-rack power/cooling boundaries (100 kW–150 kW+ per rack).

Service Level Agreements (SLAs): Co-author and refine technical SLAs, Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) guarantees, and environmental operating parameters within customer leases.

2. Project Buildout & Delivery Governance

Milestone Reporting: Provide enterprise clients with transparent progress updates across Civil/PEB milestones, MEP fit-out, long-lead equipment delivery, and Level 1–5 commissioning sequences.

Customer Change Management: Manage client-requested scope changes, evaluate cost and schedule impacts with the PMO team, and oversee execution of technical variation orders.

Audit & Inspection Facilitation: Organize and lead client technical teams through factory acceptance testing (FAT), field site walk-throughs, and Level 5 Integrated Systems Testing (IST) validations.

3. Relationship Management & Retention

Single Point of Contact (SPOC): Serve as the trusted single point of contact for customer escalations, schedule alignments, and operational readiness reviews.

Post-Handover Transition: Facilitate smooth transitions from construction/commissioning leads to live facility operations teams, ensuring client fit-out and server rack deployment start on time.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

Experience: 8–12+ years in technical customer account management, solutions engineering, or project delivery within hyperscale data centers or cloud infrastructure.

Technical Core: Solid understanding of data center design, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, power distribution (UPS/Busways), and high-density AI rack specifications.

Client Management: Proven track record managing C-suite, engineering, and procurement executives at major hyperscale (cloud) providers or large AI technology enterprises.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or Business/Construction Management.

Key Skills: SLA/MSA contract negotiation, technical client presentation, project progress reporting, change order negotiation, and cross-functional team leadership.

* Solid understanding of PDLC methodologies, risk management practices, and quality metrics relevant to software development.
* Strong background in software testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and integration testing.
* Technically astute, with the ability to bridge the gap between engineering and product for high-quality, scalable deliveries.
* Proactive, with exceptional analytical skills and a passion for implementing quality governance in complex, cross-functional environments.
* A collaborative problem-solver, skilled at navigating fast-paced environments while enforcing technical standards and operational excellence.

7122a79b.title: IT Infrastructure Program Manager
7122a79b.description:
Position Summary
  
  
Responsible for leading complex cybersecurity programs and strategic security initiatives across the enterprise. This role drives cross-functional execution, manages security risks and dependencies, coordinates with security, infrastructure, and business teams, and ensures successful delivery of security objectives aligned with organizational priorities, compliance requirements, and risk management goals. The individual operates with significant autonomy and influences decision-making across multiple stakeholder groups..
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Security Program Leadership**

* Lead enterprise cybersecurity programs, including risk remediation, vulnerability management, compliance initiatives, identity security, cloud security, security operations, and governance programs.
* Develop and manage integrated program roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, budgets, and resource plans.
* Drive execution of board, executive, and regulatory security commitments.
* Ensure alignment between security strategy, technology roadmaps, and business objectives.

**Risk & Findings Management**

* Drive end-to-end remediation of security findings, audit observations, penetration testing gaps, and risk register items.
* Facilitate prioritization of remediation efforts with Security, Infrastructure, and Business leaders.
* Coordinate risk acceptance and exception processes where remediation is not feasible.
* Maintain visibility into security risks and provide executive-level reporting on mitigation progres.

**Executive Stakeholder Management**

* Act as a trusted advisor to Security leadership, PMO leadership, and senior business stakeholders.
* Prepare executive-ready status reports, dashboards, risk assessments, and decision materials.
* Facilitate steering committees, governance reviews, and leadership discussions.
* Drive alignment among multiple technical teams, vendors, and business functions.

**Program Delivery & Governance**

* Establish and maintain program governance, RAID logs, action tracking, and decision registers.
* Manage interdependencies across Security, Network, Platform & Hosting, EUC, Engineering, and third-party vendors.
* Ensure delivery using Agile, SAFe, hybrid, or traditional methodologies as appropriate.
* Drive issue resolution and escalation management to maintain delivery commitments.

**Compliance & Regulatory Initiatives**

* Coordinate programs supporting NIST, ISO 27001, CMMC, ITAR, SOX, NIS2, and other regulatory requirements.
* Track security control implementation and compliance milestones.
* Partner with Governance, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure audit readiness and evidence collection.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Drive process improvements within security planning, risk management, and project delivery practices.
* Implement metrics and KPIs to measure cybersecurity program effectiveness.
* Promote best practices for governance, reporting, prioritization, and dependency management.
* Mentor junior project managers and contribute to PMO standards and methodologies..

**Required Skills**

* Strong experience managing complex IT infrastructure projects across Network, Platform, Hosting, and Cloud
* Expertise in Agile/Scrum and traditional project management methodologies
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow (PPM/ITSM modules preferred)
* Solid understanding of enterprise infrastructure architecture and integration points
* Proven ability to manage cross-functional and multi-vendor environments
* Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, and influencing skills

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Ability to solve complex problems using multiple data sources and independent judgment
* Strong communication and ability to influence stakeholders and build consensus
* High ownership and accountability for delivery outcomes
* Ability to operate independently with minimal guidance 5+ years of experience developing enterprise automation, integrations, or infrastructure engineering solutions.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* 5-10 years of experience in IT project/program management, preferably in IT infrastructure domains PMP / PRINCE2 / Agile Scrum certification (preferred)

**Nice To Have**

* Experience in large-scale infrastructure transformation or outsourcing programs (MSP engagements)
* Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) and hybrid infrastructure environments
* Familiarity with ITIL frameworks and enterprise service management practices

**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Who We Are**
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, everything starts and ends with our mission:
  
  
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
  
  
We have the vision of a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. These aren’t easy goals to accomplish – but we’re not here for easy. We’re here for better. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
  
  
We’re changing the nature of work. Palo Alto Networks is evolving to meet the needs of our employees now and in the future through FLEXWORK, our approach to how we work. From benefits to learning, location to leadership, we’ve rethought and recreated every aspect of the employee experience at Palo Alto Networks. And because it FLEXes around each individual employee based on their individual choices, employees are empowered to push boundaries and help us all evolve, together.
  
  
**Your Career**
The Solutions Consultant is the evolution of the traditional Sales Engineering role, aligning how we best serve our customers in understanding their environment, providing solution guidance and ensuring value realization in their investment with Palo Alto Networks. As a Solutions Consultant you provide technical leadership and expertise and guidance in your customer’s security transformation journey.
