46426302.title: Senior Cloud & AI Platform Engineer
46426302.description:
**Req ID:** 393747
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Senior Cloud AI Platform Engineer to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
**Job Profile:** Senior Cloud AI Platform Engineer
  
  
**Job Summary:**  
We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Cloud AI Platform Engineer to architect, build, and operate enterprise-scale AI platforms across multi-cloud environments. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platform engineering, DevSecOps automation, AI/LLM model serving, GPU infrastructure, and platform reliability. This role will focus on delivering secure, scalable, and high-performing AI platforms that support modern AI and GenAI workloads.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Design, implement, and manage cloud-native AI platforms across Azure and GCP.
* Deploy and administer Kubernetes and OpenShift environments for enterprise AI workloads.
* Develop Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions and automate platform provisioning using Terraform and CI/CD pipelines.
* Build and maintain AI/LLM serving infrastructure for production-scale model deployment.
* Optimize GPU infrastructure, resource utilization, and performance for AI workloads.
* Develop automation solutions, APIs, and platform services using Python and REST-based integrations.
* Implement secure authentication, authorization, and API management frameworks.
* Establish observability, monitoring, and reliability standards across AI platforms.
* Collaborate with Data Science, Engineering, Security, and Operations teams to deliver scalable AI solutions.
* Drive platform governance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Primary Skills:**  
1. Cloud Platforms (Azure, GCP)
  
2. Kubernetes OpenShift (GKE, AKS, OCP)
  
3. Infrastructure as Code DevSecOps (Terraform, CI/CD)
  
4. Python API Engineering (REST, SDKs, Automation)
  
5. AI/LLM Platform Engineering Model Serving (vLLM, Triton, TGI)
  
6. GPU Infrastructure Performance Optimization
  
7. Identity, Security API Gateway Integration (OAuth2, Service Accounts)
  
8. Observability Reliability Engineering (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Arize)
  
  
Secondary Skills
  
  
1. Agentic AI MCP Architectures
  
2. LiteLLM and Model Routing Frameworks
  
3. NVIDIA AI Ecosystem (NIM, NeMo, DGX, SuperPOD)
  
4. Vector Databases RAG Solutions
  
5. Enterprise Networking Cloud Connectivity
  
6. AI FinOps Capacity Management
  
7. Distributed Systems Scalability Engineering
  
8. AI Platform Productization Operational Excellence
  
  
About NTT DATA
  
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us.

94abb330.title: Solution Architect
94abb330.description:
**SOLUTION ARCHITECT**
**We are looking for a Solution Architect to be part of our Nestlé Nespresso Digital and Tech Team. At Nespresso, our Digital & Tech teams are at the heart of our innovation journey, a space where we continue to invest, evolve, and grow.**
**Position Snapshot:**

* Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
* Type of Contract: Permanent
* Grade: Band 2
* Type of work: Hybrid
* Work Language: Fluent Business English

**The Role:**
As a
**Solutions Architect**
, you will work within a team of Enterprise and Solution Architects across the Nespresso Tech landscape. You'll handle multiple projects related to both transformation and business evolution, delivering End-to-End Solution Architecture and overseeing its implementation.
  
  
In this role, you will manage the Enterprise and Solution Architecture for Nespresso’s global application landscape, supporting all markets and HQ functions. You will also be part of a team that drives innovation and new features for the business, all while spearheading a digital transformation to enhance competitiveness and speed to the market.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will:**

* Deliver architectural designs and input to the roadmap, translating business needs into comprehensive technical solutions.
* Facilitate the evaluation and selection of software products and services, and design standard and custom software configurations.
* Implement and integrate solutions, crafting integration strategies for cross-application purposes.
* Guide the technical architecture implementation across product groups, ensuring alignment with business strategies and requirements.
* Identify organizational and financial impacts of solution architecture.
* Monitor the current-state solution portfolio to identify technology deficiencies or misalignments with business requirements.
* Oversee governance activities to ensure product architecture security, assurance, and compliance.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, systems analysis, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of experience in IT solution development disciplines (solution architecture, technical architecture, network management, application development, middleware, database management, or operations).
* Experience in translating future-state business capabilities and requirements into solution architecture requirements.
* Excellent understanding of application development methodologies and infrastructure/network architecture.
* Ability to estimate the financial impact of solution architecture alternatives.
* Familiarity with diverse technologies and processing environments (REST/SOAP APIs, Event-driven architectures, micro-services, cloud, and on-premises solutions).
* Experience documenting End-to-End architectures using UML and/or C4 diagrams.

**Extra Skills That Set You Apart:**

* Experience with Confluent Kafka.
* Experience with Mulesoft API Gateway.
* Experience in CommerceTools.
* Experience with Dynamics 365 suite (CRM, Commerce or Customer Service)
* Experience in LeanIX.

**We Offer You:**
We offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.
  
  

* Flexible work policies including core hours and options for working from home. Discuss with us during the recruitment process to understand what flexibility could look like for you!
* Genuine opportunities for career and personal development through ongoing training and constant career opportunities reflecting our conviction that people are our most important asset.
* Modern "smart office" locations providing agile workspaces. Our state-of-the-art campus is equipped with areas to co-create, network, and chill!
* International, dynamic & inclusive working environment with attractive additional benefits.
* The pride to work for a B Corp certified company and one of the world’s most trusted brands.

**The Hiring Process:**

* Your Application: Submit your application, and we'll review it carefully (make sure your CV is in English as the hiring team is international).
* Initial Screening: Relevant candidates will be contacted by our Talent Acquisition team for an initial interview.
* Hiring Manager Interview: Selected candidates will then meet with the hiring manager to discuss the role and their experience in more detail.
* Stakeholder Interview: Candidates will engage with potential team members to assess fit and collaboration.
* Leadership & HRBP Interaction: Candidates will have a discussion with our leadership team & HRBP.
* Feedback: After interviews, we provide feedback to all candidates.
* Job Offer: Successful candidates will receive a formal offer.
* First Working Day: Once the offer is accepted, we’ll welcome you on your first day!

**About Nespresso:**
The Nespresso story began with a simple but revolutionary idea: enable anyone to create the perfect cup of espresso coffee.
  
  
Since 1986, Nespresso has redefined and revolutionized the way millions of people enjoy their coffee.
  
  
We are a Company committed with the Climate change and we aim to achieve carbon neutrality as soon as possible and net-zero GHG emissions by 2050 at the latest.
  
  
In 2019 we created the digital hub in Barcelona to offer the best customer experience and innovation to B2C and B2B channels.
  
  
*We encourage the diversity of applicants across gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, sexual orientation, social background, religion or belief and disability.*
People are at the heart of our success – all 14,000 of them. We actively cultivate diversity, inclusion and belonging in the workplace. We celebrate individuality, believing that your authenticity and uniqueness can help us to grow and thrive together
  
  
Step outside your comfort zone; share your ideas, way of thinking and working to make a difference to the world, every single day. You own a piece of the action – make it count.
  
  
**Join Nestlé #beaforceforgood**
#Nespresso

You will work closely with Product Owners, Software Architects, developers, cybersecurity experts and globally distributed engineering teams to translate product requirements into robust cloud-native solutions.
  
  
The role provides an opportunity to influence architecture from edge to cloud, establish reusable technology patterns and enable engineering teams to build secure, scalable and maintainable digital solutions.

**As a Cloud Architect, You Will**
Define and drive end-to-end cloud architecture for IoT and digital applications.

Establish cloud architecture principles, reusable design patterns, standards and technology guidelines.

Architect solutions based on microservices, containers, Kubernetes, serverless technologies and managed cloud services.

Define architectural approaches for high availability, scalability, disaster recovery and performance.
  
  
Enable DevOps/DevSecOps practices, automated CI/CD and cloud-native deployments.
  
  
Define observability concepts covering system monitoring, logging, metrics and alerting.
  
  
Evaluate and recommend appropriate cloud technologies, platforms, frameworks and tools.
  
  
Lead architecture and design reviews and support teams in resolving complex technical issues.
  
  
Mentor engineering teams and promote cloud-native architecture and engineering practices.
  
  
Collaborate with globally distributed R&D teams and other stakeholders on technology and product roadmaps.

Strong professional experience in software engineering, cloud technologies and solution architecture.
  
  
Proven experience designing scalable, secure and highly available cloud applications.

Strong knowledge of cloud networking, security and identity/access management.

Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform or comparable technologies.

Strong knowledge of software architecture principles, system design and design patterns.
  
  
Strong analytical, debugging and problem-solving capabilities.
  
  
Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.
  
  
Ability to technically lead, influence and mentor engineering teams.

a5a5dcb8.description:
**Description**
Amazon Device Troubleshooting Team exist to ensure device and application customers have delightful experiences using the product by enabling swift, precise, and privacy-compliant observability and issue resolution across all devices and applications. Our mission is to transform vast amounts of device data into actionable insights that drive product stability and customer satisfaction. To achieve this mission, we provide comprehensive technology solutions spanning the entire observability lifecycle. This includes on-device crash and log management, high-scale data ingestion services, advanced analytics dashboards, and intuitive troubleshooting interfaces.
  
  
As a Senior Technical Program Manager for the Amazon Device Troubleshooting Services team, you will drive critical initiatives that enhance the detection, diagnosis, and resolution of issues across Amazon's device ecosystem. This high-visibility role requires exceptional leadership in coordinating across several engineering teams, data engineers, applied scientists,BIEs and senior stakeholders to deliver scalable troubleshooting solutions that improve customer experience. You will be responsible for influencing feature priorities and getting buy in from engineering teams for delivery of large cross-organization programs. You will leverage your technical knowledge to drive technical trade-off decisions. You will represent difficult trade-off decisions and solutions clearly to technical and business leaders to help them understand decisions and options. As a Technical Program Manager, you will be one of the key leaders on the team and have an impact by defining strategy & requirements, developing processes & schedules, and driving forward progress on major initiatives.
  
  
As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will bring strong project management skills to systematically drive programs and deliver results. You possess good technical skills to deal with ambiguous programs to drive clarity in scope and execution. You are have demonstrated ability in driving programs with multiple stakeholders, use escalation mechanisms and negotiation skills to drive the right outcomes. You have good communication skills, both written and verbal and are adept in communicating with stakeholders and executives with right level of detail and clarity.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As the Senior Technical Program Manager, you will drive key business collaborations critical to improving the customer experience with Amazon Devices.
  
  

* You will partner with Senior Leaders within Amazon Devices to identify opportunities to increase device stability, reduce device resource utilizations, save costs and improve efficiency.
* You will define and implement strategical partnerships that enables businesses in Amazon Devices scale faster, save costs, and improve efficiency.
* You will establish mechanisms and processes that drive continuous improvement and operational efficiency.
* You will establish metrics and design self-serve reports to keep stake-holders informed and excited about the progress

A day in the life
  
  
This role will drive engagement across different product lines to design and drive programs that will improve the stability, reduce the resource utilization of the devices. You will also help build mechanisms to prevent duplication of tools across teams for troubleshooting and analysis. As a direct result, this role offers the challenge as well as the opportunity to bring structure and clarity to a fast-moving space. This high visibility role is inherently cross-organizational in nature. You will be a champion of this product to senior leadership.
  
  
**About The Team**
Amazon Device Troubleshooting Services (ADTS) team ensures that troubleshooting is quick, easy, and privacy-centric for device and application teams, so that end customers have delightful experiences with their Amazon Devices. We provide a single place for device and application teams to troubleshoot known issues, uncover emergent trends or regressions, and quantify the impact in the context of the customer journey. We build technology to deliver high-quality user experiences for troubleshooting and analysis, ensure stability of the device, and proactively present critical issues and root causes to relevant teams based on a wide range of health and customer journey data.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience using English communication skills, both written and verbal, to foster seamless interaction with stakeholders at all levels

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
* Experience leading highly technical programs involving infrastructure, complex systems, systems engineering
* Experience managing technical programs across cross-functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience managing communication with geographically distributed teams

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. 382feeab.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Amazon Freight
382feeab.description:
**Description**
We are building a large tech organization for Amazon Freight from scratch. Amazon Freight is now part of Amazon Supply Chain Services and is building an innovative transportation network with the vision of redefining shipping for its customers. To grow our Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) and Truckload (TL) business continues, we are looking to building state of the art and brand new (1) network capabilities (2) shipper/seller facing capabilities (3) science capabilities execution optimization.
  
  
The new team will be building foundational core capabilities around (1) Shipment Execution- Quoting and Booking, Carrier/Driver Workflow , Shipper Workflow ,shipper signals, Driver/Shipper Handoffs, 3P Site Intelligence, demand side Disruption Mgmt (2) Trailer Operations - Trailer Pool Mgmt. , Equipment Assignment, Quality & Prep (3) Scheduling & Optimization - Shipper Scheduling workflow, Cost-Optimal Demand shaping, Cancellations/Reschedules (4) Cost, Demand & Volume Planning - Cost Planning & Prediction , Forecasting.
  
  
This position requires strong business judgment, exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with operational excellence, is comfortable making data-driven decisions in ambiguous environments and has experience translating complex transportation economics into scalable network execution strategies. If you are passionate about solving complex transportation problems, influencing cross-functional partners, and building innovative supply chain capabilities that create value for customers while driving sustainable business growth, we'd love to speak with you
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Define and deliver large-scale, cross-organizational programs by identifying gaps between architectures, services, and organizations, decomposing complex problems into clear solutions, and driving alignment across engineering teams toward coherent technology strategies.
* Own technology roadmaps for broad sets of systems or manage a portfolio of programs, applying deep technical knowledge to evolve, improve, and simplify technologies while minimizing recurring engineering effort.
* Drive business and system-level reviews, assess risk, and represent complex decisions and trade-offs clearly to senior leadership, enabling informed decision-making up to three levels above your role.
* Create, optimize, and drive adoption of mechanisms that ensure long-term program success, proactively steering teams away from prior failure patterns and identifying when additional technical guidance is needed.
* Amplify impact across the organization by mentoring other program managers, sharing best practices, and contributing to talent development through assessments and community events.

A day in the life
  
  
You might start your morning reviewing a technical design document alongside senior engineers, asking pointed questions to uncover hidden dependencies. By midday, you could be facilitating a cross-team alignment session to resolve competing priorities across multiple service owners. In the afternoon, you may draft a narrative for a VP-level review, distilling weeks of analysis into a clear recommendation with well-defined trade-offs. Throughout it all, you balance strategic thinking with hands-on problem solving, ensuring that the programs you lead move forward with the right urgency and quality.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our team is focused on solving some of Amazon's most complex technical and organizational challenges. We work across business and engineering boundaries to deliver programs that have lasting impact on how Amazon builds and operates at scale. We value collaboration, intellectual curiosity, and a commitment to raising the bar for everyone around us. If you are excited about defining strategy in uncharted territory and partnering with leaders across the company to bring it to life, this is the team for you.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5+ years of software development experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

5215b3f8.title: Senior Partner Solutions Engineer - APAC

The Sr. Partner Solutions Engineer is a highly experienced technical lead responsible for driving the growth and technical enablement of our key partners (National Partners, Value-Added Resellers (VARs), and System Integrators) across Australia, NewZealand, Singapore and Philippines.

This senior individual contributor role reports directly to the Vice President, Partner Solution Engineering. You will act as the primary technical point of contact, supporting partners in establishing and scaling their Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) and Customer Experience Automation (CXA) practices built around the Talkdesk platform. This role involves deep technical engagement, partner enablement, co-selling support, and providing technical thought leadership to ensure mutual partner and customer success across the assigned territories.

**Key Responsibilities** **Partner Enablement & Practice Development**

* **Lead Technical Enablement:** Design and execute comprehensive enablement plans to educate partner Solutions Architects and Sales Engineers on the Talkdesk value proposition, product architecture, competitive differentiators, and roadmap.
* **Partner Center of Excellence:** Support the development of Partner Competency Centers by coaching on effective technical discovery, platform demonstrations, and proof-of-concept (POC) execution.
* **Domain Expertise:** Develop and maintain deep domain expertise in the regional Partner landscape, understanding their current go-to-market (GTM) strategy, areas of focus, and identifying new opportunities for expansion.

**Co-Selling Support & Technical Leadership**

* **Agentic AI Focus:** Provide technical expertise on **Agentic AI** solutions within the contact center, including prompt engineering, RAG implementations, tools integration, and guardrail best practices.
* **Customer Engagement:** Provide technical oversight, guidance, and direct assistance to Partner sales teams in understanding complex customer business and technical requirements, use cases, and solution design.
* **Solution Demonstration:** Lead advanced technical discussions, conduct compelling demonstrations of the Talkdesk platform, and articulate the ease of integration within an enterprise ecosystem.
* **Ecosystem Integration:** Develop a deep understanding of the enterprise ecosystem, including integration requirements with **CRM** (e.g., Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics), **WFM, Knowledge Management, and UCaaS** vendors.

**Strategic Contribution & Communication**

* **Voice of the Partner:** Act as the critical communication channel to Talkdesk Product Management and Engineering teams, relaying Partner and customer needs, market trends, and product enhancement requests.
* **Market Representation:** Represent Talkdesk as a technical expert at regional Partner summits, technical events, webinars, and conferences.
* **Travel:** Ability to travel approximately **35-70%** of the time across Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, and other ASEAN countries as required.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* **Regional Experience:** 10+ years of experience as a **Partner Solutions Engineer** or Pre-Sales Engineer in the **CCaaS/CXA** sector.
* Language Requirements: Professional fluency in English is required. Proficiency in additional regional languages (e.g., Filipino) is highly desirable.
* **Communication:** **Excellent communication, presentation, and whiteboard session skills** with an ability to lead advanced technical discussions and deliver compelling platform demonstrations for enterprise customers & Partners.
* **Partner Background:** Solid experience working with **Service Providers, Regional Systems Integrators, National Partners, and VARs**, with a proven understanding of a partner-centric GTM approach within the APAC markets.
* **Technical Leadership:** Proven ability to lead and drive complex technical engagements and serve as a subject matter expert without direct people management responsibilities.
* **Telephony & Protocol Knowledge:** Experience with at least one **Unified Communication protocol** (e.g., SIP, WebRTC, RTP) and familiarity with Call/Message processing Proxies and Session Border Controllers.
* **Applied AI Expertise:** Hands-on experience or strong familiarity with modern **Agentic AI** technologies, including the practical application of LLMs for Contact Center and Customer Experience Automation use cases.
* **Education:** Bachelors degree in Engineering, Computer Science, MIS, or an equivalent combination of education and years of relevant experience.

Talkdesk is pioneering a new era of Customer Experience Automation (CXA), redefining how the world s most admired brands interact with their customers through AI. Our global team of courageous innovators is customer-obsessed, building AI-first solutions that put empathy, trust, and transparency at the center of every interaction. We foster an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives drive our success and every voice belongs. Combining the stability of a global leader with the agility of a disruptor, Talkdeskers are empowered with the autonomy to drive meaningful impact, while giving back to the communities and environment around us.

Talkdesk has been recognized as a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) and in the G2 Overall Grid Reports for AI Agents and Contact Center. With seven consecutive years on the Forbes Cloud 100 and multiple AI Breakthrough awards, there has never been a more exciting time to join us as we shape the future of customer experience automation!

**Work Environment and Physical Requirements:**

Primarily office-environment work, extended periods of sitting or standing, computer-based work. Limited lifting, and equipment usage limited to computer-related equipment (keyboards, mouse, etc.)

The Talkdesk story hinges on empathy and acceptance. It is the shared goal among all Talkdeskers to empower a new kind of customer hero through our innovative software solution, and we firmly believe that the best path to success for our mission is inclusivity, diversity, and genuine acceptance. To that end, we will hire, promote, work along, cheer for, bond with, and warmly welcome into the Talkdesk family all persons without regard to ethnic and racial identity, indigenous heritage, national origin, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

  
  
Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.

e5cd95fb.description:
**Position: Oracle Cloud GL (General Ledger) — Application Support Consultant**
Location: Hyderabad - Remote
  
  
Shift Timing: 3.00AM - 12.00PM PST (US Pacific Time)
  
  
Engagement Type: Full Time
  
  
**About the Role:**
We are looking for an experienced Oracle Cloud General Ledger (GL) Support Consultant with strong hands-on functional expertise in Oracle Cloud GL, with proven experience resolving production issues, handling period-close activities, and providing day-to-day operational support in a live Oracle Cloud Financials environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide L2/L3 production support for Oracle Cloud General Ledger module, ensuring timely resolution of incidents and service requests within defined SLAs
* Manage and troubleshoot day-to-day GL issues: journal posting errors, allocation failures, reconciliation mismatches, ledger balancing issues
* Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities including journal review, accruals, revaluation, translation, and consolidation
* Monitor and resolve issues in scheduled processes (ESS jobs) related to GL — posting, import, allocations, period close
* Handle intercompany transactions, elimination entries, and cross-ledger balancing issues
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring issues and recommend permanent fixes/configuration changes
* Coordinate with Oracle Support (SRs/Service Requests) for bug fixes, patches, and quarterly update issues
* Support functional testing of Oracle Cloud quarterly patches/updates and regression testing for GL processes
* Work closely with sub-ledger (AP, AR, FA & CM) support teams to resolve cross-module integration issues impacting GL
* Assist in FBDI-based data loads, journal uploads, and correction of failed interface/import processes
* Maintain and update support documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles
* Handle minor enhancements, CRs (Change Requests), and configuration updates as per business need
* Provide end-user support, training, and query resolution related to GL processes
* Track tickets via ITSM tools (ServiceNow, JIRA, Remedy, etc.) and report on SLA compliance and ticket trends
* Participate in on-call/rotational support and be available during period-close windows (including weekends, if required)

**Required Skills:**

* 6–8 years of experience in Oracle applications, with at least 4–5 years dedicated to Oracle Cloud GL support/operations
* Strong hands-on experience in a production support environment
* Solid understanding of GL configurations: Chart of Accounts, Ledgers, Calendars, Journal Sources/Categories, Data Access Sets
* Practical experience with allocations, revaluation, translation, and consolidation processes
* Experience handling period-close cycle issues and providing close-window support
* Working knowledge of GL integration points with AP, AR, FA, CM, and Expenses
* Hands-on experience with OTBI, FRS (Financial Reporting Studio), and Smart View for troubleshooting/reporting issues
* Familiarity with FBDI templates and resolving failed import/interface issues
* Experience raising and managing Oracle Service Requests (SRs) via My Oracle Support (MOS)
* Understanding of Oracle Cloud release cycles (quarterly updates) and their impact on GL configurations
* Good knowledge of ITSM/ticketing tools (ServiceNow, JIRA, Remedy)
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize under pressure

8dfd670c.title: Business Solutions Engineer
8dfd670c.description:
**About TruKKer and the Role**

TruKKer is hiring a Business Solutions Engineer who owns the full journey from a business problem to a solution people actually use, building with Claude Code on top of our existing systems.

TruKKer is a technology-driven road freight and logistics company. Our business teams run on fast-moving, process-heavy workflows, and many of their pain points are best solved by small, well-targeted software rather than long project cycles.

The Business Solutions Engineer sits inside that gap: one person, embedded with the business, who can understand a problem, decide what to build, build it, prove it works, roll it out and keep it useful. There are no hand-offs between a business analyst, a product manager, a developer and a tester.

  

**The Business Solutions Engineer is all of them for the solutions they own.**

  

If you prefer working from requirements someone else has already

written, this is not the role. If you would rather spend a morning with an operations team, find where hours are leaking every week, and have something working in front of them soon after, read on.

  

**Role Summary**

The Business Solutions Engineer is the single owner of a solutions entire lifecycle. You start by understanding what the business team is struggling with, and you finish only when the team is using the solution and getting value from it.

  

**In practice you will:**

* Spend time with business teams to find and define real problems, not just take requests.
* Research the product options and gather requirements from the right stakeholders.
* Build the solution end to end using Claude Code, either as an enhancement to an existing system or a new build from scratch.
* Test it yourself, end to end, before anyone else sees it.
* Train the business team, launch the solution and stay on as its owner.
* Track adoption, and when usage is low, find out why and fix it.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

The work runs in seven stages. You own every one of them.

**1. Discover and understand business challenges**

* Work closely with business teams to learn how they operate day to day and where time, money or accuracy is being lost.
* Identify and prioritise the problems worth solving, using impact, effort and urgency.
* Define each problem clearly, with a measurable outcome, before any solution is proposed.

**2. Research and define the solution**

* Research the product space: how similar problems are solved elsewhere, and whether to enhance an existing system or build something new.
* Gather and document requirements from the relevant stakeholders (business users, managers, data owners, engineering).
* Propose a solution with scope, trade-offs and success criteria, and get alignment before building.

**3. Build end to end with Claude Code**

* Design and develop the solution using Claude Code, either as an enhancement within TruKKer’s existing systems or as a new build from scratch.
* Handle the full stack of the solution: data, logic, integrations, interface and deployment.
* Make sound decisions on architecture, security, access control and maintainability, and review AI-generated code with care.
* Keep documentation current so others can understand and support what you have built.

**4. Test it yourself**

* Own end-to-end testing: functional, integration, edge cases, data accuracy and user-flow checks.
* Validate with realistic business data and scenarios, and fix issues before release.

**5. Train and implement**

* Set up and run training and walkthrough sessions with the business team.
* Prepare simple guides or demos so users can adopt the solution without hand-holding.
* Manage the rollout and go-live, including the first weeks of hypercare.

**6. Support and enhance**

* Be the point of contact for business queries, issues and enhancement requests on your solutions.
* Triage and resolve issues quickly, and scope, build and ship enhancements as needs evolve.

**7. Drive adoption**

* Monitor whether each solution is actually being used, by whom and how often.
* If usage is low, sit down with the business to find the real reason (workflow fit, trust, training, missing features, process change).
* Provide and deliver the fix, whether that is a product change, more training or a process adjustment, until the solution is part of how the team works.

  

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

We care more about what you can build and own than about the title on your last job.

* 3 to 6 years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, product engineering or a similar hands-on role.
* Strong full-stack ability: you can read and write backend logic, work with databases and APIs, and build a usable front end.
* Hands-on experience building with AI coding tools, ideally Claude Code, and the judgement to review, test and correct AI-generated code.
* Proven ability to take a vague business problem, break it down, and turn it into clear requirements and a working solution.
* Comfortable working inside existing systems: reading unfamiliar code, integrating with current tools and making safe changes.
* Disciplined self-testing habits, covering functional checks, edge cases and data validation.
* Excellent communication: you can talk to a non-technical operations team and a senior engineer in the same day, and run a good training session.
* High ownership and follow-through, with a bias for action and for finishing what you start.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in logistics, supply chain, freight, marketplaces or other operations-heavy businesses.
* Familiarity with ERP, TMS, CRM or similar enterprise systems and their integrations.
* Experience with BI and analytics tools for building dashboards and usage tracking.
* Prior experience in a forward deployed, solutions engineering or internal tools role.
* Product management exposure, such as writing PRDs, prioritising backlogs and running user research.

**Who You Will Work With**

You will work daily with business teams such as operations, sales, customer success and finance, and with the product, engineering and data colleagues who own the systems you build on. The business reaches out to you directly, so you must be comfortable being the face of the solution.

  

**How Success Is Measured**

The Business Solutions Engineer is judged on outcomes the business can feel, not on lines of code shipped. Targets are set with the hiring manager once the role is filled.

* Problem-solution fit — Solutions shipped that address a validated business problem, with a stated outcome
* Delivery speed — Time from problem identified to solution live
* Quality — Defects found after go-live, and rework needed after release
* Adoption — Share of intended users actively using the solution, and how that trends after launch
* Business impact — Time saved, errors reduced, or revenue or cost effect, versus the baseline
* Responsiveness — Time to respond to and resolve business queries and enhancement requests
* Stakeholder satisfaction — Feedback from business teams on trust, clarity and support

7e7fa0f2.title: Salesforce Field Service Architect

**Description**
Our Field Service Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that craft the future.
  
  
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include--but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
As a core part of this role, you will realize solutions for our customers by focusing on consultancy, technical development & delivery for the customers and partners to solve critically meaningful business challenges using Salesforce’s Field Service Platform (SFS). Salesforce FS product provides FSM solutions for a wide variety of customer verticals and ecosystem(s) like Telecom, Utilities, Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, Finance etc.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**Requirements**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End-to-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes

1adf0493.title: Lead Cloud Architect
1adf0493.description:
**About the Company**

Holotwins Bharat Private Limited is a cutting-edge technology company specializing in Digital Twins, Industrial AI, and Emerging Technologies. We empower global organizations to model, simulate, and optimize complex physical systems through intelligent virtual replicas—driving smarter decisions, predictive maintenance, and next-generation operational efficiency.

Serving high-impact sectors including manufacturing, energy, and logistics, we bridge physical infrastructure with intelligent data via AR/VR/XR and IoT ecosystems. As a proud member of the AWS Partner Network (APN), we build secure, scalable, and resilient industrial cloud applications that help scale global innovation.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a visionary Lead Cloud Architect with 7+ years of experience to drive our multi-cloud strategy and engineering practices. In this role, you will design, secure, and automate robust architectures across both AWS and Azure to power our advanced Digital Twin platforms. You will bridge the gap between software engineering (.NET / Python) and modern cloud operations, embedding robust DevSecOps and CI/CD principles into everything we build.

* Location: 100% Fully Remote (Work from anywhere in India)
* Engagement: Heavy focus on Foreign Client Engagements, collaborating with international partners and cross-border enterprise deployments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Multi-Cloud Architecture: Design, build, and optimize scalable, resilient, and cost-effective enterprise solutions across AWS and Azure to host heavy IoT, AI, and visualization workloads.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Author, maintain, and scale modular infrastructure using Terraform to ensure rapid, consistent deployments globally.
* Identity & Governance: Architect and enforce enterprise-grade security controls, specifically managing Azure RBAC, Azure Active Directory / Entra ID, and AWS IAM policies.
* DevSecOps & CI/CD: Establish shift-left security principles by embedding automated security tools (SAST/DAST, container vulnerability scanning) into global pipelines.
* GitHub Integration: Architect end-to-end version control strategies, secure repository governance, and GitHub Actions/Workflows for smooth developer self-service.
* Global Client Collaboration: Act as a technical subject matter expert during engagements with international clients, understanding their architectural constraints and aligning them with our technology ecosystem.
* Technical Leadership: Collaborate closely with development teams to provide code support and architectural alignment in .NET or Python.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience: 10+ years of total experience in IT/Software Engineering, with at least 4+ years operating as a dedicated Cloud Architect.
* Cloud Platforms: Deep, production-proven expertise in both Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure.
* Programming: Strong coding proficiency in either .NET (C#) or Python for automation, backend services, or cloud-native integrations.
* Automation & IaC: Mastery of Terraform for multi-cloud infrastructure provisioning.
* CI/CD & Git: Expert-level knowledge of GitHub integration, repository governance, branch strategies, and complex CI/CD pipeline automation.
* Security & Compliance: Deep understanding of DevSecOps best practices, secure coding standards, and fine-grained access management via Azure RBAC.
* Communication: Exceptional English communication and consultative skills tailored for direct foreign client-facing engagements.

**Preferred Certifications**

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional / AWS Certified DevOps Engineer
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert / DevOps Engineer Expert
* HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate

**What We Offer**

* 100% Fully Remote Work Setup offering true work-life flexibility.
* Direct exposure to high-impact, global enterprise digital transformation projects.
* A tech-first culture that values continuous learning, absolute automation, and technical excellence.
* Competitive compensation packages aligned with your senior leadership level.

2cbbc78d.title: Principle Architect (Modular Construction)
2cbbc78d.description:
**Job Title: Project Design Lead – (Modular Construction)**

**Location:**
Modulus Housing, Chettipedu, Chennai-602105

**Department:**
Engineering + Operations

**Type:**
Full-Time, Onsite

**Join a Team Engineering the Future of Construction: Modular Building Technology (MBT)About Us**

We are revolutionising construction through
**Modular Building Technology (MBT)**
— where factory-born precision meets the simplicity of LEGO-like on-site assembly.

Our mission is to create
**intuitive, resilient, scalable**
spaces built with the speed and clarity of a product, not a traditional project.

We operate with an
**Intense & Scrappy**
mindset, believe
**Scale is Magic**
, and live by the principle:
**Nothing is someone else’s problem.**

Every system we build, and every module we ship, is rooted in our MBT Focus:
**Make Something People Love.**

**The Role: Own the Space Between Design, Factory & Site.**
This is
**not**
a coordinator role.

This is a
**high-agency leadership role**
responsible for ensuring that:

* Designs are
  **buildable**
* Factory production is
  **aligned & unblocked**
* Site execution is
  **flawless & predictable**
* Projects remain
  **profitable**
* Teams move
  **in sync**
  without friction
* Issues are
  **solved early**
  and permanently

You will be the person who transforms initial concepts into
**fully aligned, execution-ready packages**
— ensuring clarity from design → manufacturing → logistics → site installation.

**Key Responsibilities1. Front-End Engineering & Feasibility (Digital → Factory → Site)**

* Break down project concepts into
  **clear engineering inputs**
  for design, factory and site.
* Validate feasibility early — tolerances, module sizing, access, sequencing, logistics.
* Drive design freeze and ensure all teams have clarity before production begins.
* Create and maintain simple, intuitive
  **installation and coordination instructions**
  .

**2. Project Orchestration & Execution Clarity**

* Act as the
  **single point of accountability**
  connecting design, manufacturing, procurement, logistics, and site teams.
* Run project kickoff sessions with assumptions, risks, and alignment questions.
* Monitor dependencies, track progress, unblock teams, and escalate intelligently.
* Ensure every deliverable meets
  **factory-ready**
  quality and
  **site-ready**
  clarity.

**3. Profitability, Budget Control & Risk Intelligence**

* Compare
  **Budget vs Actual (BvA)**
  across materials, labor, logistics, rework, and timelines.
* Identify engineering or process root causes for variances.
* Implement early-warning signals to catch overruns before they occur.
* Drive continuous improvements to improve predictable project margins.

**4. Issue Resolution & Cross-Team Accountability**

* Solve conflicts between teams with clarity, empathy, and speed.
* Design says manufacturing is asking too many changes
* Manufacturing says design is not buildable
* Site says installation sequence is unclear
* Create “never again” systems and processes for recurring issues.
* Maintain a high bar for communication and documentation.

**5. Process Building & Standardisation**

* Build SOPs for design freeze, factory release, installation readiness, RFIs, etc.
* Implement checklists & coordination frameworks that scale.
* Build dashboards or trackers for clarity (materials, timelines, dependencies).

**Required Skills & ExperienceTechnical & Operational Skills**

* Strong understanding of
  **Modular Construction**
  workflows
* Clear understanding of
  **manufacturing constraints**
  and
  **site execution logic**
* Ability to foresee problems before they reach production or site
* Excellent coordination, planning, and critical path management skills
* Strong analytical skills (costing, BvA, timelines, data-driven decisions)

**Experience**

* 3–10 years in
  **project coordination, front-end engineering, modular/precast construction, offsite manufacturing, or integrated construction delivery roles**
  .
* Experience working closely with design, manufacturing, and site teams.
* Experience handling project budgets, cost tracking, and risk mitigation.

**Mindset & Personality**

* High agency: you don’t wait — you drive clarity.
* “Nothing is someone else’s problem” mindset.
* Thrives in fast, intense, dynamic environments.
* Structured thinking, exceptional communication.
* Comfortable taking responsibility and making decisions with imperfect information.

**Values Alignment (Mandatory)**

You must resonate deeply with our values:

* **Scale is Magic**
* **Intense & Scrappy**
* **Make Something People Love**
* **Nothing is Someone Else’s Problem**
* **Think Like a Factory; Build Like LEGO**

**Why You’ll Love Working With Us**

* **High Impact Role**
  : You directly determine how smoothly and profitably projects get delivered.
* **Cutting-Edge Environment**
  : Work in India’s most forward-thinking modular construction ecosystem.
* **Collaborative Culture**
  : Work daily with design innovators, manufacturing teams, and execution-focused site leaders.
* **Growth**
  : Become one of the key orchestrators of India’s scaling modular industry.
